articles.title: "You are an expert annotator": Automatic Best-Worst-Scaling Annotations for Emotion Intensity Modeling
articles.abstract: Labeling corpora constitutes a bottleneck to create models for new tasks or domains. Large language models mitigate the issue with automatic corpus labeling methods, particularly for categorical annotations. Some NLP tasks such as emotion intensity prediction, however, require text regression, but there is no work on automating annotations for continuous label assignments. Regression is considered more challenging than classification: The fact that humans perform worse when tasked to choose values from a rating scale lead to comparative annotation methods, including best-worst scaling. This raises the question if large language model-based annotation methods show similar patterns, namely that they perform worse on rating scale annotation tasks than on comparative annotation tasks. To study this, we automate emotion intensity predictions and compare direct rating scale predictions, pairwise comparisons and best-worst scaling. We find that the latter shows the highest reliability. A transformer regressor fine-tuned on these data performs nearly on par with a model trained on the original manual annotations.
articles.titleCn: “你是专家标注者”：用于情绪强度建模的最佳最差量表自动标注
articles.abstractCn: 标注语料库是创建新任务或领域模型的一大瓶颈。大型语言模型通过自动语料库标注方法缓解了这一问题，尤其是在分类标注方面。然而，某些自然语言处理任务（如情绪强度预测）需要文本回归，但目前还没有研究自动化连续标签分配的标注方法。与分类相比，回归被认为更具挑战性：由于人类在从评分量表中选择值时表现较差，导致了比较标注方法的出现，包括最佳-最差量表法。这引发了这样一个问题：基于大型语言模型的标注方法是否表现出类似模式，即它们在评分量表标注任务上的表现是否不如在比较标注任务上。为了研究这一点，我们自动化了情绪强度预测，并比较了直接评分量表预测、成对比较和最佳-最差量表法。我们发现后者的可靠性最高。在上述数据上微调的Transformer回归器在表现上几乎与在原始人工标注数据上训练的模型相当。

articles.title: A Systematic Review of NLP for Ghanaian Languages: Datasets, Models, and a Research Roadmap
articles.abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) for Ghana's 73 living indigenous languages remains deeply fragmented, under-resourced, and heavily skewed toward a single language. We present the first systematic review of the Ghanaian NLP landscape, screening 17,000+ publications across four academic databases to critically synthesize 36 core studies spanning datasets, model architectures, and evaluation paradigms. Our analysis exposes a severe resource imbalance: Twi-centric NLP has grown modestly, driven largely by religious-text alignment and crowdsourcing, while the remaining 70+ languages remain almost entirely unaddressed, and dataset releases, model checkpoints, and evaluation practices remain inconsistent and rarely shared across the field. We translate these findings into a prioritized roadmap targeting Ghana's acute regional constraints, dialectal variation, non-standardized orthographies, and the absence of shared infrastructure, offering a replicable template for systematic review and research prioritization in other low-resource language settings.
articles.comment: 8 main pages. Includes an appendix with supplementary methodology and abstract translations in 15 languages
articles.titleCn: 加纳语言自然语言处理系统综述：数据集、模型与研究路线图
articles.abstractCn: 加纳73种现存本土语言的自然语言处理（NLP）仍处于严重碎片化、资源匮乏且高度偏向单一语言的状态。我们首次对加纳NLP领域进行了系统性综述，通过筛选四大学术数据库中的17,000余篇文献，批判性地整合了涵盖数据集、模型架构和评估范式的36项核心研究。我们的分析揭示了资源严重失衡的问题：以阿肯语（Twi）为中心的NLP发展相对缓慢，主要受宗教文本对齐和众包驱动，而其余70多种语言几乎完全未被关注，数据集发布、模型检查点和评估实践仍缺乏一致性且极少在领域内共享。我们将这些发现转化为针对加纳区域限制、方言差异、非标准化正字法及共享基础设施缺失的优先路线图，为低资源语言环境中的系统性综述和研究优先级制定提供了可复制的模板。

articles.title: Unleash LLMs Potential for Sequential Recommendation by Coordinating Dual Dynamic Index Mechanism
articles.abstract: Owing to the unprecedented capability in semantic understanding and logical reasoning, large language models (LLMs) have shown fantastic potential in developing next-generation sequential recommender systems (RSs). However, existing LLM-based sequential RSs mostly separate index generation from sequential recommendation, leading to insufficient integration between semantic information and collaborative information. On the other hand, the neglect of user-related information hinders LLM-based sequential RSs from exploiting high-order user-item interaction patterns. In this paper, we propose the End-to-End Dual Dynamic (ED$^2$) recommender, the first LLM-based sequential RS which adopts dual dynamic index mechanism, targeting resolving the above limitations simultaneously. The dual dynamic index mechanism can not only assembly index generation and sequential recommendation into a unified LLM-backbone pipeline, but also make it practical for LLM-based sequential recommender to take advantage of user-related information. Specifically, to facilitate the LLM comprehension ability to dual dynamic index, we propose a multigrained token regulator which constructs alignment supervision based on LLMs semantic knowledge across multiple representation granularities. Moreover, the associated user collection data and a series of novel instruction tuning tasks are specially customized to capture the high-order user-item interaction patterns. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate the superiority of ED$^2$, achieving an average improvement of 19.62% in Hit-Rate and 21.11% in NDCG.
articles.titleCn: 通过协调双重动态索引机制来释放序列推荐的LLM潜力
articles.abstractCn: 由于在语义理解和逻辑推理方面具有前所未有的能力，大型语言模型（LLMs）在开发下一代序列推荐系统（RSs）方面展现出巨大的潜力。然而，现有的基于LLMs的序列推荐系统大多将索引生成与序列推荐分离，导致语义信息与协同信息之间的整合不足。另一方面，对用户相关信息的忽视阻碍了基于LLMs的序列推荐系统利用高阶用户-物品交互模式。在本文中，我们提出了端到端双重动态（ED$^2$）推荐系统，这是首个采用双重动态索引机制的基于LLMs的序列推荐系统，旨在同时解决上述限制。双重动态索引机制不仅可以将索引生成和序列推荐集成到一个统一的LLM骨干管道中，还可以使基于LLMs的序列推荐系统能够利用用户相关信息。具体而言，为了促进LLM对双重动态索引的理解能力，我们提出了一种多粒度标记调节器，该调节器基于跨多个表示粒度的LLM语义知识构建对齐监督。此外，我们还专门定制了相关的用户集合数据和一系列新颖的指令微调任务，以捕捉高阶用户-物品交互模式。在三个公共数据集上的大量实验表明，ED$^2$具有优越性，在Hit-Rate上平均提高了19.62%，在NDCG上平均提高了21.11%。

articles.title: Which Demographics do LLMs Default to During Annotation?
articles.abstract: Demographics and cultural background of annotators influence the labels they assign in text annotation -- for instance, an elderly woman might find it offensive to read a message addressed to a "bro", but a male teenager might find it appropriate. It is therefore important to acknowledge label variations to not under-represent members of a society. Two research directions developed out of this observation in the context of using large language models (LLM) for data annotations, namely (1) studying biases and inherent knowledge of LLMs and (2) injecting diversity in the output by manipulating the prompt with demographic information. We combine these two strands of research and ask the question to which demographics an LLM resorts to when no demographics is given. To answer this question, we evaluate which attributes of human annotators LLMs inherently mimic. Furthermore, we compare non-demographic conditioned prompts and placebo-conditioned prompts (e.g., "you are an annotator who lives in house number 5") to demographics-conditioned prompts ("You are a 45 year old man and an expert on politeness annotation. How do you rate {instance}"). We study these questions for politeness and offensiveness annotations on the POPQUORN data set, a corpus created in a controlled manner to investigate human label variations based on demographics which has not been used for LLM-based analyses so far. We observe notable influences related to gender, race, and age in demographic prompting, which contrasts with previous studies that found no such effects.
articles.titleCn: 在标注过程中，LLM默认倾向于哪些人群？
articles.abstractCn: 标注人员的统计特征和文化背景会影响他们在文本标注中赋予的标签——例如，一位年长的女性可能会觉得阅读一条以“兄弟”称呼的留言令人不快，而一个男性青少年可能会认为这是合适的。因此，承认标签的多样性以避免低估社会成员的重要性至关重要。在利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行数据标注的背景下，这一观察催生了两个研究方向，即（1）研究LLM的偏见和固有知识，以及（2）通过用人口统计信息操纵提示来增加输出多样性。我们将这两条研究线索结合起来，并提出了一个问题：当未给出人口统计信息时，LLM会诉诸于哪些群体。为了回答这个问题，我们评估了LLM在多大程度上会模仿人类标注者的属性。此外，我们将非人口统计条件提示和安慰剂条件提示（例如，“你是一位住在5号房子的标注者”）与人口统计条件提示（“你是一位45岁的男性，是礼貌标注方面的专家。你如何评价{实例}”）进行比较。我们针对POPQUORN数据集进行了这项研究，该数据集是一个受控创建的语料库，用于研究基于人口统计的人类标签差异，迄今为止尚未用于基于LLM的分析。我们观察到与性别、种族和年龄相关的人口统计提示具有显著影响，这与先前发现没有此类效应的研究形成对比。

articles.title: Accelerating Stateful Network Applications with Performance Prediction on SoC SmartNICs
articles.abstract: Offloading stateful network functions to multi-threaded SoC SmartNICs promises significant performance and cost benefits. However, realizing this potential is hindered by two fundamental challenges. First, without performance guidance, developers are forced into a slow, manual trial-and-error cycle of deploying and testing to find a feasible resource allocation. Second, sustaining performance under changing traffic requires adapting state residency and handling overload within memory layouts fixed at compile time. This paper introduces Vela, a framework that addresses both challenges through a model-driven, compile-time/runtime co-design. Its core is a predictive compiler that replaces the manual tuning loop with fast, automated analysis, using a novel, state-centric analytical model to estimate the throughput ceiling of any given resource allocation plan. This is complemented by a lightweight runtime that dynamically manages cache contents within the compiled memory layout and mitigates overload. We implement and evaluate Vela on Netronome Agilio and NVIDIA BlueField 3 SmartNICs across four NFs. Vela reduces host CPU or on-board Arm core usage by 62.9%-91.9% relative to the best baseline achieving the same throughput. For the NATLB workload, vela also improves throughput by 15.2%-120.8% over the best baseline at the same host/Arm core count.
articles.titleCn: 基于SoC智能网卡的性能预测加速有状态网络应用
articles.abstractCn: 将状态ful网络功能卸载到多线程SoC智能网卡上，有望带来显著的性能和成本效益。然而，实现这一潜力受到两个基本挑战的阻碍。首先，在没有性能指导的情况下，开发者被迫进入缓慢的手动试错循环，通过部署和测试来寻找可行的资源分配方案。其次，在流量变化的情况下维持性能需要调整状态驻留并在编译时固定的内存布局中处理过载。本文介绍了Vela，一个通过模型驱动、编译时/运行时协同设计来解决这两个挑战的框架。其核心是一个预测性编译器，它用快速自动分析来取代手动调优循环，使用一种新颖的状态中心分析模型来估计任何给定资源分配方案的吞吐量上限。这由一个轻量级的运行时补充，它动态管理编译内存布局中的缓存内容并减轻过载。我们在Netronome Agilio和NVIDIA BlueField 3智能网卡上对四个网络功能实现了并评估了Vela。与实现相同吞吐量的最佳基线相比，Vela将主机CPU或板载Arm核心使用率降低了62.9%-91.9%。对于NATLB工作负载，在相同的主机/Arm核心数量下，Vela在最佳基线的基础上还提高了15.2%-120.8%的吞吐量。

articles.title: Label-Confidence-Aware Uncertainty Estimation in Natural Language Generation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in generative tasks but pose potential risks due to their tendency to generate hallucinatory responses. Therefore, Uncertainty Quantification (UQ), which aims to distinguish the validity of answers, is crucial for ensuring the safety and robustness of AI systems. However, existing methods primarily rely on measuring the entropy of multiple stochastic samples to represent uncertainty, often overlooking the specific uncertainty information associated with the candidate answer under evaluation. This oversight can lead to biased classification outcomes. In this paper, we investigate the discrepancy between global entropy from multiple samples and local confidence of candidate answer, and propose a Label-Confidence-Aware Uncertainty Quantification (LCA-UQ) method based on Pointwise Kullback-Leibler (PKL) divergence. Our method effectively bridges the gap between the consistency of sampled outputs and the calibration of the candidate answer, thereby enhancing the reliability and stability of uncertainty assessments. Empirical evaluations across a range of popular LLMs and NLP datasets reveal that label sources significantly impact classification. Furthermore, our approach effectively captures the nuances between sampling results and label sources, demonstrating superior performance in uncertainty estimation.
articles.titleCn: 自然语言生成中的标签置信度感知不确定性估计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成任务中展现出卓越的能力，但由于其倾向于生成幻觉式响应，也带来了潜在风险。因此，不确定性量化（UQ），旨在区分答案的有效性，对于确保人工智能系统的安全性和鲁棒性至关重要。然而，现有方法主要依赖于测量多个随机样本的熵来表示不确定性，往往忽略了评估候选答案时与之相关的具体不确定性信息。这种疏忽可能导致分类结果产生偏差。在本文中，我们研究了从多个样本中获得的全局熵与候选答案的局部置信度之间的差异，并提出了一种基于点式Kullback-Leibler（PKL）散度的标签置信度感知不确定性量化（LCA-UQ）方法。我们的方法有效地弥合了采样输出一致性与候选答案校准之间的差距，从而提高了不确定性评估的可靠性和稳定性。在一系列流行的LLMs和NLP数据集上的实证评估表明，标签来源对分类具有显著影响。此外，我们的方法有效地捕捉了采样结果与标签来源之间的细微差别，在不确定性估计方面表现出优越的性能。

articles.title: Divide and Conquer: A Hybrid Strategy Defeats Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely applied in various fields of society due to their powerful reasoning, understanding, and generation capabilities. However, the security issues associated with these models are becoming increasingly severe. Jailbreaking attacks, as an important method for detecting vulnerabilities in LLMs, have been explored by researchers who attempt to induce these models to generate harmful content through various attack methods. Nevertheless, existing jailbreaking methods face numerous limitations, such as excessive query counts, limited coverage of jailbreak modalities, low attack success rates, and simplistic evaluation methods. To overcome these constraints, this paper proposes a multimodal jailbreaking method: JMLLM. This method integrates multiple strategies to perform comprehensive jailbreak attacks across text, visual, and auditory modalities. Additionally, we contribute a new and comprehensive dataset for multimodal jailbreaking research: TriJail, which includes jailbreak prompts for all three modalities. Experiments on the TriJail dataset and the benchmark dataset AdvBench, conducted on 13 popular LLMs, demonstrate advanced attack success rates and significant reduction in time overhead.
articles.titleCn: 分而治之：混合策略击败多模态大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）因其强大的推理、理解和生成能力，在社会各个领域得到了广泛应用。然而，与这些模型相关的安全问题日益严重。越狱攻击作为一种检测LLMs漏洞的重要方法，已被研究人员探索，他们试图通过多种攻击方法诱导这些模型生成有害内容。尽管如此，现有的越狱方法面临诸多限制，例如查询次数过多、越狱模式覆盖范围有限、攻击成功率低以及评估方法简单。为了克服这些约束，本文提出了一种多模态越狱方法：JMLLM。该方法整合了多种策略，在文本、视觉和听觉模态上进行全面的越狱攻击。此外，我们为多模态越狱研究贡献了一个新的综合数据集：TriJail，其中包含适用于所有三种模态的越狱提示。在TriJail数据集和基准数据集AdvBench上对13个流行的LLMs进行的实验，展示了更高的攻击成功率和显著的时间开销降低。

articles.title: PBEBench: A Multi-Step Programming by Examples Reasoning Benchmark inspired by Historical Linguistics
articles.abstract: Although many benchmarks evaluate the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) within domains such as mathematics, coding, or data wrangling, few abstract away from domain specifics to examine reasoning as a capability in and of itself. We contribute a novel type of benchmark evaluating the inductive reasoning capabilities of LLMs that is inspired by the forward reconstruction task from historical linguistics but is formulated in an extremely simple, general way (in the form of Programming by Examples). The task involves generating a cascade of simple string rewrite programs to transform a given list of input strings into a list of desired output strings. We present a fully automated pipeline that programmatically generates problems of this type with controllable difficulty, enabling scalable evaluation of reasoning models while avoiding contamination. Using this approach, we construct two benchmarks: PBEBench-Lite, which efficiently stratifies models of varying capabilities, and PBEBench, which requires models to induce programs similar in complexity to those constructed by historical linguists. Our experiments reveal a substantial performance gap between models that leverage test-time compute or LCoT (long chain-of-thought) reasoning and those that do not. Moreover, although recent models show promise, the solve rate for both of them drops below 5% for hard instances of the PBEBench dataset (ground truth cascade lengths of 20 and 30, respectively), falling well short of realistic historical linguistics requirements even with computationally expensive, popular scaling techniques from the PBE and reasoning literature. Additionally, we also study the effectiveness of different scaling strategies and the impact of various hyperparameters on the difficulty of the generated data using gpt-oss-120b, the best-performing open-source model.
articles.titleCn: PBEBench：一个受历史语言学启发的多步编程示例推理基准
articles.abstractCn: 尽管许多基准测试评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在数学、编程或数据整理等领域的推理能力，但很少有基准测试脱离领域特定性，将推理本身作为一种能力进行考察。我们贡献了一种新型基准测试，用于评估LLMs的归纳推理能力，该测试灵感来源于历史语言学中的正向重构任务，但以极其简单、通用的方式（以编程示例的形式）进行表述。该任务涉及生成一系列简单的字符串重写程序，以将给定的输入字符串列表转换为期望的输出字符串列表。我们提出了一种全自动的流程，可以程序化地生成此类问题，并控制难度，从而实现推理模型的规模化评估，同时避免污染。通过这种方法，我们构建了两个基准测试：PBEBench-Lite，该基准测试高效地分层了不同能力的模型；以及PBEBench，该基准测试要求模型推导出与历史语言学家构建的程序在复杂度上相似的程序。我们的实验揭示，利用测试时计算或长链式思维（LCoT）推理的模型与不利用这些技术的模型之间存在显著的性能差距。此外，尽管近期模型显示出潜力，但它们在PBEBench数据集的困难实例（真实情况级联长度分别为20和30）上的解决率均低于5%，即使使用PBE和推理文献中计算成本高昂、流行的扩展技术，也远未达到现实中的历史语言学要求。此外，我们还研究了不同扩展策略的有效性，以及各种超参数对生成数据难度的 影响，使用了表现最佳的开放源模型gpt-oss-120b。

articles.title: Donate or Create? Comparing Data Collection Strategies for Emotion-labeled Multimodal Social Media Posts
articles.abstract: Accurate modeling of subjective phenomena such as emotion expression requires data annotated with authors' intentions. Commonly such data is collected by asking study participants to donate and label genuine content produced in the real world, or create content fitting particular labels during the study. Asking participants to create content is often simpler to implement and presents fewer risks to participant privacy than data donation. However, it is unclear if and how study-created content may differ from genuine content, and how differences may impact models. We collect study-created and genuine multimodal social media posts labeled for emotion and compare them on several dimensions, including model performance. We find that compared to genuine posts, study-created posts are longer, rely more on their text and less on their images for emotion expression, and focus more on emotion-prototypical events. The samples of participants willing to donate versus create posts are demographically different. Study-created data is valuable to train models that generalize well to genuine data, but realistic effectiveness estimates require genuine data.
articles.titleCn: 捐赠还是创建？比较用于情绪标签的多模态社交媒体帖子的数据收集策略
articles.abstractCn: 对情绪表达等主观现象进行精确建模需要带有作者意图的数据标注。通常此类数据是通过要求研究参与者捐赠并标注真实世界中产生的真实内容，或在研究过程中创建符合特定标签的内容来收集的。要求参与者创建内容通常更容易实施，并且对参与者隐私的风险也更小。然而，尚不清楚研究创建的内容与真实内容之间是否存在差异，以及这些差异如何影响模型。我们收集了带有情绪标签的研究创建内容与真实内容的多模态社交媒体帖子，并在多个维度上进行了比较，包括模型性能。我们发现，与真实帖子相比，研究创建的帖子更长，更多地依赖文本而非图像来表达情绪，并且更关注典型情绪事件。愿意捐赠内容与愿意创建内容的参与者具有不同的人口统计学特征。研究创建的数据对于训练能够很好地泛化到真实数据的模型是有价值的，但现实有效的效果评估需要真实数据。

articles.title: Modelling Adjectival Modification Effects on Semantic Plausibility
articles.abstract: While the task of assessing the plausibility of events such as "news is relevant" has been addressed by a growing body of work, less attention has been paid to capturing changes in plausibility as triggered by event modification. Understanding changes in plausibility is relevant for tasks such as dialogue generation, commonsense reasoning, and hallucination detection, as it allows to correctly model, for example, "false news is relevant", which is of lower relevance but higher concern due to potential disinformation. In this work, we tackle the Adept challenge benchmark (Emami et al. 2021) consisting of 16K English sentence pairs differing by exactly one adjectival modifier (e.g., false.) Our modeling experiments provide a conceptually novel method using sentence transformers and reveal that sentence transformers struggle despite their conceptual alignment with the task at hand, underperforming in comparison to transformers like RoBERTa. Finally, we discuss our findings in relation to prior work and present a detailed error analysis to shed light on potential sources for ST underperformance, highlighting advantages and shortcomings of the examined methods for balancing out train and test data.
articles.titleCn: 形容词修饰对语义合理性影响的建模
articles.abstractCn: 尽管评估“新闻相关性”等事件的可能性这一任务已得到越来越多的研究关注，但针对事件修改所引发的可能性变化的研究却较少。理解可能性变化与对话生成、常识推理和幻觉检测等任务相关，因为它允许正确地建模例如“假新闻相关性”这类关联度较低但更受关注的问题，因为假新闻可能引发虚假信息传播。在本工作中，我们处理了Adept挑战基准（Emami等人，2021），该基准包含16K对仅由一个形容词修饰符不同的英语句子（例如，“假”）。我们的建模实验提出了一种概念上新颖的方法，使用句子转换器，并揭示尽管句子转换器在概念上与任务相符，但它们的表现不佳，与RoBERTa等转换器相比存在性能差距。最后，我们将研究结果与先前工作进行比较，并呈现了详细的错误分析，以阐明句子转换器表现不佳的潜在原因，并强调了所考察方法在平衡训练和测试数据方面的优缺点。

articles.title: AgentPack: A Dataset of Code Changes, Co-Authored by Agents and Humans
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models for code editing has typically relied on mining commits and pull requests. The working hypothesis has been that commit messages describe human intent in natural language, and patches to code describe the changes that implement that intent. However, much of the previously collected data is noisy: commit messages are terse, human-written commits commingle several unrelated edits, and many commits come from simple, rule-based bots. The recent adoption of software engineering agents changes this landscape. Code changes \emph{co-authored} by humans and agents are often accompanied by substantially more explicit natural-language descriptions of intent and rationale. Moreover, when these changes land in public repositories, they are implicitly filtered by humans: maintainers discard low-quality commits to their projects. We present AgentPack, a corpus of 1.8M code edits co-authored by Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Cursor Agent across public GitHub projects up to early October 2025. We describe the identification and curation pipeline, quantify adoption trends of these agents, and analyze the structural properties of the edits. Finally, we show that models fine-tuned on AgentPack can outperform models trained on prior human-only commit corpora, highlighting the potential of using public data from software engineering agents to train future code-editing models.
articles.titleCn: AgentPack：一个由代理和人类共同编写的代码变更数据集
articles.abstractCn: 为代码编辑微调大型语言模型通常依赖于挖掘提交记录和拉取请求。其工作假设是提交信息以自然语言描述人类意图，而代码补丁则描述实现该意图的变更。然而，先前收集的大部分数据存在噪声：提交信息简短，人类编写的提交常常混杂多个不相关的编辑，且许多提交来自基于规则的简单机器人。近年来，软件工程代理的采用改变了这一格局。由人类和代理共同编写的代码变更通常伴随着更明确、更详细的自然语言意图和理由描述。此外，当这些变更提交到公共仓库时，它们会被人类隐式筛选：维护者会丢弃其项目中的低质量提交。我们提出了AgentPack，这是一个包含180万次代码编辑的语料库，这些编辑由Claude Code、OpenAI Codex和Cursor Agent在截至2025年初的公共GitHub项目上共同完成。我们描述了识别和筛选的流程，量化了这些代理的采用趋势，并分析了编辑的结构特性。最后，我们证明，在AgentPack上微调的模型可以优于在先前仅有人类提交语料库上训练的模型，突显了使用软件工程代理的公共数据来训练未来代码编辑模型的潜力。

articles.title: Seeing Through the MiRAGE: Evaluating Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: We introduce MiRAGE, an evaluation framework for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from multimodal sources. As audiovisual media becomes a more prevalent source of information online, RAG systems must integrate such media into generation. Yet, existing evaluation methods for RAG are largely text-centric and do not readily transfer to multimodal settings. MiRAGE is a claim-centric approach to multimodal RAG evaluation, consisting of InfoF1, which assesses factuality and information coverage, and CiteF1, which assesses citation support and completeness. We show that, when applied by humans, MiRAGE strongly aligns with extrinsic judgments of output quality. We additionally introduce an automatic implementation of MiRAGE and compare it to multimodal variants of three prominent text-centric RAG metrics---ALCE, ARGUE, and RAGAS---finding that MiRAGE outperforms all three on text while being the only one to generalize to multimodal sources. We release open-source implementations and outline evaluation methods for multimodal RAG.
articles.titleCn: 透过MiRAGE：评估多模态检索增强生成
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了MiRAGE，一个用于从多模态来源进行检索增强生成（RAG）的评价框架。随着音视频媒体成为网络信息的主要来源，RAG系统必须将其整合到生成过程中。然而，现有的RAG评价方法大多以文本为中心，难以直接应用于多模态场景。MiRAGE是一种以论点为中心的多模态RAG评价方法，包括InfoF1（评估事实性和信息覆盖度）和CiteF1（评估引用支持和完整性）。我们证明，当由人类应用时，MiRAGE与输出质量的客观评价高度一致。此外，我们引入了MiRAGE的自动实现，并将其与三种主流文本中心RAG指标的多模态变体——ALCE、ARGUE和RAGAS——进行比较，发现MiRAGE在文本上表现优于所有三者，并且是唯一能够泛化到多模态来源的方法。我们发布了开源实现，并概述了多模态RAG的评价方法。

articles.title: ProofVerifier: A Scalable, Diversity-Driven Framework for Natural-Language Proof Verification
articles.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on mathematical problems with verifiable answers, many advanced problems are proof-based and require evaluating full proofs. However, training such verifiers requires diverse and trustworthy question-proof-check (QPC) examples at scale, which are scarce. To address this challenge, we develop a human-audited, LLM-assisted data pipeline that produces large-scale QPC triplets with limited human effort. By systematically varying problem sources, generation strategies, and generator models, the pipeline creates diverse problem-proof pairs spanning multiple difficulty levels, linguistic styles, and error types. We combine multi-LLM agreement with hierarchical human auditing to obtain accurate proof-correctness labels. Using these data, we train generative proof verifiers and introduce an auxiliary fluency filter together with balanced token weighting to stabilize binary-reward long-form verification RL. Experiments show that our verifier improves proof-judgment accuracy across different proof styles and provides useful guidance for test-time selection. Overall, our results provide a practical data and training framework for natural-language proof verification.
articles.titleCn: 证明验证器：一种可扩展、多样性驱动的自然语言证明验证框架
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在具有可验证答案的数学问题上取得了优异表现，但许多高级问题基于证明，需要评估完整的证明。然而，训练此类验证器需要大规模的多样化且值得信赖的问题-证明-检查（QPC）示例，而这些示例十分稀缺。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了一个经人工审核、LLM辅助的数据管道，以有限的人力投入生成大规模的QPC三元组。通过系统性地改变问题来源、生成策略和生成器模型，该管道创建了跨越多个难度级别、语言风格和错误类型的多样化问题-证明对。我们结合多LLM的一致性以及分层人工审核，以获得准确的证明正确性标签。利用这些数据，我们训练了生成式证明验证器，并引入了辅助流畅性过滤器以及平衡标记加权，以稳定二元奖励长格式验证强化学习。实验表明，我们的验证器在不同证明风格下提高了证明判断的准确性，并为测试时选择提供了有用指导。总体而言，我们的结果为自然语言证明验证提供了一种实用的数据和训练框架。

articles.title: HALT: Hallucination Assessment via Log-probs as Time series
articles.abstract: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle for large language models (LLMs), especially in safety-critical domains. We present HALT (Hallucination Assessment via Log-probs as Time series), a lightweight hallucination detector that leverages only the top-20 token log-probabilities from LLM generations as a time series. HALT uses a gated recurrent unit model combined with entropy-based features to learn model calibration bias, providing an extremely efficient alternative to large encoders. Unlike white-box approaches, HALT does not require access to hidden states or attention maps, relying only on output log-probabilities. Unlike black-box approaches, it operates on log-probs rather than surface-form text, which enables stronger domain generalization and compatibility with proprietary LLMs without requiring access to internal weights. To benchmark performance, we introduce HUB (Hallucination detection Unified Benchmark), which consolidates prior datasets into ten capabilities covering both reasoning tasks (Algorithmic, Commonsense, Mathematical, Symbolic, Code Generation) and general purpose skills (Chat, Data-to-Text, Question Answering, Summarization, World Knowledge). While being 30x smaller, HALT outperforms Lettuce, a fine-tuned modernBERT-base encoder, achieving a 60x speedup gain on HUB. HALT and HUB together establish an effective framework for hallucination detection across diverse LLM capabilities.
articles.titleCn: HALT：通过日志概率作为时间序列进行幻觉评估
articles.abstractCn: 幻觉仍然是大型语言模型（LLMs）的主要障碍，尤其是在安全关键领域。我们提出了HALT（通过日志概率作为时间序列进行幻觉评估），这是一种轻量级的幻觉检测器，它利用LLM生成的前20个token的日志概率作为时间序列。HALT使用门控循环单元模型结合基于熵的特征来学习模型校准偏差，为大型编码器提供了一种极其高效的替代方案。与白盒方法不同，HALT不需要访问隐藏状态或注意力图，仅依赖于输出日志概率。与黑盒方法不同，它基于日志概率而非表面形式文本进行操作，这使其能够实现更强的领域泛化，并与专有LLMs兼容，无需访问内部权重。为了基准测试性能，我们引入了HUB（幻觉检测统一基准），它将先前的数据集整合为十个能力，涵盖推理任务（算法、常识、数学、符号、代码生成）和通用技能（聊天、数据到文本、问答、摘要、世界知识）。虽然HALT只有Lettuce（一个微调的现代BERT-base编码器）的1/30大小，但在HUB上却实现了性能超越，并获得了60倍的加速提升。HALT和HUB共同建立了一个有效框架，用于检测不同LLM能力的幻觉。

articles.title: Patch the Distribution Mismatch: RL Rewriting Agent for Stable Off-Policy SFT
articles.abstract: Large language models are commonly adapted to downstream tasks through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but substantial distribution mismatch between downstream supervision and a model's generation distribution can intensify catastrophic forgetting. Data rewriting offers a data-centric way to narrow this mismatch before SFT. Existing methods, however, typically sample rewrites from a prompt-induced conditional distribution, which need not align with the backbone's natural question-answering generation distribution, and fixed templates can reduce output diversity. We formulate data rewriting as a policy-learning problem and train a lightweight LoRA rewriting policy with reinforcement learning. The policy optimizes question-answering-style distributional alignment and semantic diversity under a hard task-consistency gate, producing verified supervision for downstream SFT. Across three instruction-tuned backbones, the resulting models attain downstream gains broadly comparable to standard SFT while reducing degradation on non-downstream benchmarks in every evaluated setting. Additional experiments on logical reasoning and medical question answering provide preliminary evidence that a rewriting policy can be reused across domains for the same backbone.
articles.titleCn: 修复分发不匹配：用于稳定离线策略微调的强化学习重写代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常通过监督微调（SFT）应用于下游任务，但下游监督与模型生成分布之间的显著分布不匹配会加剧灾难性遗忘。数据重写提供了一种以数据为中心的方法，在SFT之前缩小这种不匹配。然而，现有方法通常从提示诱导的条件分布中采样重写，这可能与骨干网络的自然问答生成分布不匹配，并且固定模板会降低输出多样性。我们将数据重写表述为一种策略学习问题，并使用强化学习训练一个轻量级的LoRA重写策略。该策略在硬任务一致性门控下优化问答式分布对齐和语义多样性，为下游SFT生成经过验证的监督。在三个指令微调的骨干网络上，生成的模型在下游任务上的收益与标准SFT大致相当，同时在所有评估设置中减少了非下游基准上的性能下降。在逻辑推理和医学问答上的额外实验初步表明，对于相同的骨干网络，重写策略可以在不同领域重复使用。

articles.title: Mind the Style: Impact of Communication Style on Human-Chatbot Interaction
articles.abstract: Conversational agents increasingly mediate everyday digital interactions, yet the effects of their communication style on user experience and task success remain insufficiently understood. Addressing this gap, we report a between-subject user study in which participants interacted with one of two versions of a chatbot called NAVI, which assisted them in an interactive map-based 2D navigation task. The two chatbot versions were designed to differ primarily in communication style: one used a friendly and supportive tone, while the other used a direct and task-focused tone. We also included a control condition where participants did not interact with a chatbot but received the step-by-step navigation instructions. The friendly chatbot significantly increased users' communication satisfaction and was associated with higher task success than the direct chatbot. However, participants in the control condition achieved the highest task success overall, suggesting that chatbot interaction may introduce overhead in tasks that can be completed effectively using straightforward instructions. We did not find significant evidence that gender moderated the effects of communication style, although exploratory gender-stratified analyses suggested patterns that warrant further investigation. Finally, we found limited evidence of global linguistic accommodation, with only selective feature-level alignment. These findings suggest that chatbot communication style influences users' perceptions of conversational agents and may improve performance relative to less supportive chatbot designs, but the overall value of chatbot interaction depends on the task context. The study highlights the need for task-sensitive, transparent and carefully evaluated communication-style choices in conversational-agent design.
articles.titleCn: 注意风格：沟通风格对人类-聊天机器人交互的影响
articles.abstractCn: 对话代理越来越多地介入日常数字交互，但它们沟通风格对用户体验和任务成功率的影响仍未被充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们进行了一项受试间用户研究，参与者与名为NAVI的聊天机器人两个版本之一进行交互，该聊天机器人协助他们在基于交互地图的2D导航任务中操作。这两个聊天机器人版本主要在沟通风格上有所不同：一个采用友好和支持性的语气，另一个采用直接和任务导向的语气。我们还设置了一个控制条件，参与者不与聊天机器人交互，而是接收逐步的导航指令。友好型聊天机器人显著提升了用户的沟通满意度，并且与直接型聊天机器人相比，与更高的任务成功率相关。然而，控制条件下的参与者实现了最高的任务成功率，这表明在可以通过简单指令有效完成的任务中，聊天机器人交互可能会引入额外负担。我们没有发现性别在沟通风格效果上存在调节作用的显著证据，尽管探索性的性别分层分析显示出值得进一步研究的模式。最后，我们仅发现有限的证据表明存在全局语言适应，仅限于选择性特征层面的对齐。这些结果表明，聊天机器人的沟通风格会影响用户对对话代理的感知，并且相对于支持性较弱的聊天机器人设计，可能提升性能，但聊天机器人交互的整体价值取决于任务背景。该研究强调了在对话代理设计中，需要根据任务进行敏感、透明且经过仔细评估的沟通风格选择。

articles.title: CzechTopic: A Benchmark for Zero-Shot Topic Localization in Historical Czech Documents
articles.abstract: Topic localization aims to identify spans of text that express a given topic defined by a name and description. To study this task, we introduce a human-annotated benchmark based on Czech historical documents, containing human-defined topics together with manually annotated spans and supporting evaluation at both document and word levels. Evaluation is performed relative to human agreement rather than a single reference annotation. We evaluate a diverse range of large language models alongside BERT-based models fine-tuned on a distilled development dataset. Results reveal substantial variability among LLMs, with performance ranging from near-human topic detection to pronounced failures in span localization. While the strongest models approach human agreement, the distilled token embedding models remain competitive despite their smaller scale. The dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available at: https://github.com/dcgm/czechtopic.
articles.titleCn: 捷克主题：历史捷克文献中零样本主题定位的基准
articles.abstractCn: 主题定位旨在识别表达特定主题（由名称和描述定义）的文本片段。为研究该任务，我们基于捷克历史文献引入了一个人工标注的基准数据集，其中包含人工定义的主题以及手动标注的文本片段，并支持在文档和词级进行评估。评估结果基于人工共识而非单一参考标注。我们评估了一系列大型语言模型以及基于BERT微调的精炼开发数据集模型。结果显示，不同LLM之间存在显著差异，性能从接近人类的主题检测到片段定位的明显失败不等。虽然最强的模型接近人类水平，但精炼的词嵌入模型尽管规模较小仍具有竞争力。数据集和评估框架公开可在：https://github.com/dcgm/czechtopic。

articles.title: AuthorMix: Modular Authorship Style Transfer via Layer-wise Adapter Mixing
articles.abstract: The task of authorship style transfer involves rewriting text in the style of a target author while preserving the meaning of the original text. Existing style transfer methods train a single model on large corpora to model all target styles at once: this high-cost approach offers limited flexibility for target-specific adaptation, and often sacrifices meaning preservation for style transfer. In this paper, we propose AuthorMix: a lightweight, modular, and interpretable style transfer framework. We first train individual, style-specific LoRA adapters on a small set of high-resource authors: this allows for the rapid training of specialized adaptation models for each new target using layer-wise adapter mixing via reinforcement learning, necessitating only a handful of target-style training examples. AuthorMix ranks first on the combined style-meaning score among all baselines, including GPT-5.1, and substantially improves meaning preservation over the trained baselines; under human evaluation it is the only method best-or-tied on every dimension.
articles.titleCn: AuthorMix：基于层级适配器混合的模块化作者风格迁移
articles.abstractCn: 作者风格迁移的任务涉及以目标作者的风格重写文本，同时保留原始文本的含义。现有的风格迁移方法通过在大型语料库上训练单个模型来同时建模所有目标风格：这种高成本的方法在针对特定目标的适应性方面提供了有限的灵活性，并且经常为了风格迁移而牺牲意义保留。在本文中，我们提出了AuthorMix：一个轻量级、模块化且可解释的风格迁移框架。我们首先在少量高资源作者上训练独立的、特定风格的LoRA适配器：这允许通过强化学习的逐层适配器混合快速训练每个新目标的专业适应模型，仅需少量目标风格训练示例。AuthorMix在所有基线中综合风格-意义得分排名第一，包括GPT-5.1，并在意义保留方面显著优于训练的基线；在人工评估中，它是唯一在所有维度上表现最佳或持平的方法。

articles.title: A Taxonomy of Programming Languages for Code Generation
articles.abstract: The world's 7,000+ languages vary widely in the availability of resources for NLP, motivating efforts to systematically categorize them by their degree of resourcefulness (Joshi et al., 2020). A similar disparity exists among programming languages (PLs); however, no resource-tier taxonomy has been established for code. As large language models (LLMs) grow increasingly capable of generating code, such a taxonomy becomes essential. To fill this gap, we present the first reproducible PL resource classification, grouping 646 languages into four tiers. We show that only 1.9% of languages (Tier 3, High) account for 74.6% of all tokens in seven major corpora, while 71.7% of languages (Tier 0, Scarce) contribute just 1.0%. Statistical analyses of within-tier inequality, dispersion, and distributional skew confirm that this imbalance is both extreme and systematic. Our results provide a principled framework for dataset curation and tier-aware evaluation of multilingual LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 编程语言代码生成分类学
articles.abstractCn: 全球超过7,000种语言在自然语言处理资源方面存在显著差异，这促使人们系统地根据其资源丰富程度对它们进行分类（Joshi等，2020）。编程语言之间也存在类似的差异；然而，目前还没有针对代码的资源层级分类体系。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成能力上的日益增强，建立这样的分类体系变得至关重要。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了首个可复现的编程语言资源分类体系，将646种语言分为四个层级。我们发现，仅有1.9%的语言（第三层级，高资源）占据了七个主要语料库中74.6%的所有标记，而71.7%的语言（零层级，资源匮乏）仅贡献了1.0%。对层级内不平等、分散程度和分布偏斜的统计分析证实，这种不平衡既是极端的，也是系统性的。我们的研究结果为多语言LLMs的数据集管理和层级感知评估提供了一个原则性框架。

articles.title: Can We Still Trace L1 Signals? Investigating the Resilience of Native Language Signals in the LLM Era
articles.abstract: The widespread use of LLM-based writing assistance has raised an interesting question about the homogenization of English. As LLMs tend to revise texts toward mainstream English conventions reflected in their training data, the subtle fingerprints that reflect an author's native language (L1) may be gradually disappearing. This study investigates this phenomenon by analyzing native language identification (NLI) performance on academic abstracts. To this end, we construct two NLI datasets of academic abstracts extracted from arXiv and the ACL Anthology that covers eight native language groups across three time periods: pre-neural network (NN), pre-LLM, and post-LLM. We then evaluate NLI performance for each era using NLI classifiers obtained by fine-tuning LLMs. The results reveal a consistent decline in NLI performance over time. Notably, however, the decline is more pronounced from the pre-NN era to the pre-LLM era than from the pre-LLM era to the post-LLM era. This suggests that although academic English appears to have become increasingly homogenized in the LLM era, this homogenization did not suddenly emerge with the advent of LLMs; rather, it has progressed gradually since the emergence of neural approaches to language processing. Furthermore, a rewriting experiment using recent LLMs shows a larger NLI performance drop than the progression across eras alone, suggesting that increased LLM use may lead to further homogenization in the future.
articles.titleCn: 我们还能追踪L1信号吗？探究LLM时代母语信号的抗扰性
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的写作辅助工具的广泛使用引发了关于英语同质化的问题。由于LLM倾向于根据其训练数据中反映的主流英语规范来修改文本，反映作者母语（L1）的微妙特征可能会逐渐消失。本研究通过分析学术摘要的母语识别（NLI）性能来调查这一现象。为此，我们构建了两个NLI学术摘要数据集，这些摘要来自arXiv和ACL文摘库，涵盖了三个时间时期（神经网络前、LLM前和LLM后）的八个母语群体。然后，我们使用通过微调LLM获得的NLI分类器评估每个时代的NLI性能。结果表明，NLI性能随时间推移呈现持续下降的趋势。值得注意的是，从神经网络前时代到LLM前时代的下降幅度大于从LLM前时代到LLM后时代的下降幅度。这表明，尽管在LLM时代学术英语似乎变得越来越同质化，但这种同质化并非随着LLM的出现而突然出现，而是自神经语言处理方法出现以来逐渐发展的。此外，使用最新LLM进行的重写实验显示，其NLI性能下降幅度大于仅考虑时代进展的变化，这表明LLM的进一步使用可能会导致未来的进一步同质化。

articles.title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly used for various tasks, often coupled with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to boost accuracy. Recent work has shown that high label-prediction accuracy does not guarantee correct intermediate reasoning, and the causes of *reasoning flaws* vary from sample to sample, yet existing remedies either focus on a single domain or assume that one flaw type applies uniformly across samples. A simple mitigation method is to provide the model with the correct answer, but we show that this yields no consistent improvement in reasoning quality. This indicates that the problem cannot be fixed by LLMs' awareness of answers, and must instead be addressed through the *structure* of reasoning. Motivated by this, we propose CRAFT (Consensus Reasoning-knowledge-graph Aggregation for Flaw-aware Trace synthesis), which aggregates the consensus components shared across multiple candidate reasoning traces to synthesize improved ones. CRAFT consistently improves label-prediction accuracy on both logical and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforming most baselines, while its post-processed traces achieve higher quality under fine-grained benchmark evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 正确预测，错误步骤？用于鲁棒思维链合成的共识推理知识图谱
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已越来越多地应用于各种任务，通常结合思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示来提高准确性。近期研究表明，高标签预测准确性并不能保证正确的中间推理，且推理缺陷的原因在样本间各不相同，而现有解决方案或专注于单一领域，或假设同一类型的缺陷在所有样本中普遍适用。一种简单的缓解方法是向模型提供正确答案，但我们证明这种方法并不能带来推理质量的持续改进。这表明问题不能通过LLMs对答案的认知来解决，而必须通过推理的*结构*来处理。基于此，我们提出了CRAFT（基于共识推理知识图谱聚合的缺陷感知推理合成），该方案聚合多个候选推理轨迹中共享的共识组件，以合成改进的推理轨迹。CRAFT在逻辑和数学推理基准测试中始终如一地提高了标签预测准确性，优于大多数基线模型，同时其后处理的推理轨迹在细粒度基准评估中实现了更高的质量。

articles.title: Schema-Key Wording as an Instruction Channel in Structured Generation under Constrained Decoding
articles.abstract: Constrained decoding is widely used to make large language models produce structured outputs that satisfy schemas such as JSON. Existing work mainly treats schemas as structural constraints, overlooking that schema-key tokens also enter the autoregressive context and may guide generation. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first systematic study of schema keys as an implicit instruction channel under constrained decoding. We formulate structured generation as a multi-channel instruction problem, where task signals can be placed in prompts, schema keys, or both. We further provide a projection-aware analysis that gives a sufficient condition under which an unconstrained expected-score advantage of an instructional key is preserved after grammar projection. Experiments on GSM8K and Math500 across seven language models show that changing only schema-key wording can substantially affect accuracy, with both positive and negative effects across models. Prompt-level and schema-level instructions also interact non-additively. The evidence is substantially stronger on GSM8K than on Math500. Our findings show that schema design is not merely output formatting, but part of instruction specification in structured generation.
articles.comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of AACL-IJCNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 在受限解码的有序生成中，模式-键词作为指令通道
articles.abstractCn: 约束解码被广泛用于使大型语言模型生成满足JSON等模式的结构化输出。现有工作主要将模式视为结构约束，忽略了模式键标记也会进入自回归上下文并可能指导生成。据我们所知，我们首次系统地研究了在约束解码下，模式键作为隐式指令通道的作用。我们将结构化生成表述为一个多通道指令问题，其中任务信号可以放置在提示、模式键或两者中。我们进一步提供了一种投影感知分析，给出了在语法投影后，指令键的无约束预期分数优势得以保留的充分条件。在GSM8K和Math500上对七个语言模型的实验表明，仅改变模式键措辞就能显著影响准确率，且不同模型中存在正面和负面影响。提示级和模式级的指令也存在非加性相互作用。在GSM8K上的证据比在Math500上更强。我们的研究表明，模式设计不仅是输出格式化，也是结构化生成中指令规范的一部分。

articles.title: How Do Document Parsers Break? Auditing Structural Vulnerability in Document Intelligence
articles.abstract: Document Layout Analysis (DLA) pipelines provide structured page representations for retrieval-augmented generation, long-document question answering, and related applications. Yet their robustness evaluation remains largely area-centric. We identify this Footprint Bias and propose ProSA, a lightweight output-level auditing framework that decouples controlled probing, policy-driven targeting, and structure-aware diagnosis. ProSA combines Block-level Structural Loss Rate (B-SLR), granularity-aware exposure descriptors, and pathway attribution to analyze where structural identity is lost, at what exposure granularity failures emerge, and how failures propagate. Across MinerU and PP-StructureV3 on 1,000 pages, affected area weakly tracks perturbation-induced OCR instability ($R^2=0.384/0.110$), whereas B-SLR aligns much more closely with it ($R^2=0.727/0.916$). Exposure descriptors further separate occlusion- and topology-dominant pathways, while matched-footprint structural probes cause much larger downstream QA/retrieval drops than area-matched erasure. These results shift DLA robustness evaluation from footprint-based measurement toward structure-aware vulnerability auditing.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Code: https://github.com/ef1026/ProSA
articles.titleCn: 文档解析器如何失效？审计文档智能中的结构化漏洞
articles.abstractCn: 文档布局分析（DLA）流程为检索增强生成、长文档问答及相关应用提供结构化的页面表示。然而，其鲁棒性评估仍主要基于领域中心。我们识别出这种“足迹偏差”，并提出ProSA，这是一个轻量级的输出级审计框架，将受控探测、策略驱动目标定位和结构感知诊断解耦。ProSA结合了块级结构损失率（B-SLR）、粒度感知暴露描述符和路径归因，用于分析结构身份丢失的位置、暴露粒度失败出现的情况以及失败如何传播。在MinerU和PP-StructureV3上对1,000页文档进行测试，受影响区域仅弱相关于扰动引起的OCR不稳定性（$R^2=0.384/0.110$），而B-SLR与之关联性显著更强（$R^2=0.727/0.916$）。暴露描述符进一步区分了遮挡主导和拓扑主导的路径，而匹配足迹的结构探针导致的下游问答/检索性能下降远大于区域匹配的擦除。这些结果将DLA鲁棒性评估从基于足迹的测量转向结构感知的脆弱性审计。

articles.title: Multi-Hop Knowledge Composition is Bound by Pretraining Exposure
articles.abstract: Large Language Models fail at implicit multi-hop reasoning: a model answers "When was $X$ born?" and "Who is $Y$'s closest friend?" correctly but fails on "When was $Y$'s closest friend born?" in a single forward pass, even when both facts are perfectly memorized and individually retrievable. We study this failure in a controlled natural language setting with a strict separation between individuals exposed to compositional contexts during pretraining and those that never appear in any such context. We confirm that compositional failure persists even at 97% 1-hop accuracy, establishing the gap as a pretraining failure rather than a knowledge absence. We propose and test nine data-centric augmentation formats and find that compositional pretraining transfers to unseen questions for exposed individuals, but never to individuals absent from compositional pretraining, suggesting that exposure to compositional contexts during pretraining is a necessary condition for implicit multi-hop reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ykrmm/composition-bound .
articles.titleCn: 多跳知识组合受限于预训练曝光
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在隐式多跳推理方面表现不佳：模型能正确回答“X何时出生？”和“Y最亲近的朋友是谁？”的问题，但在单次前向传递中却无法正确回答“Y最亲近的朋友何时出生？”，即使这两个事实都被完美记忆且可单独检索。我们在严格控制的自然语言环境下研究这种失败，确保在预训练期间接触组合上下文的个体与从未出现在任何此类上下文中的个体严格分离。我们证实，即使1跳准确率达到97%，组合失败依然存在，这表明该差距是预训练失败而非知识缺失所致。我们提出了并测试了九种以数据为中心的增强格式，发现组合预训练能够迁移到未接触过的个体，但从未迁移到未参与组合预训练的个体，这表明在预训练期间接触组合上下文是隐式多跳推理的必要条件。代码可在https://github.com/ykrmm/composition-bound获取。

articles.title: When Cognitive Graphs Meet LLMs: BDEI Cognitive Pathways for Panic Emotional Arousal Prediction
articles.abstract: Predicting the timing of individual and collective panic emotional arousal before manifestation is essential for timely emergency intervention. Existing methods incorporate cognitive elements but none of them model emotion in the generative direction of the arousal process, leaving arousal timing undetermined. We argue that grounding prediction in appraisal emotion theory is necessary because it models this process explicitly in its natural generative direction, but three problems must be solved. (1) Appraisal theory posits that emotion arises from simultaneous evaluation across multiple threat dimensions, yet no prior work fuses these inputs into risk perception; (2) Existing models are trained in the opposite, behavior-bridged direction, recovering emotion merely as a post-hoc correlate of behavior; (3) Approaches that adopt LLMs as the primary decision-maker yet overlook the fragility and hallucination-proneness of their outputs. We introduce PanicCognitivePath (PCP) to address all three. A Psychological Safety Distance (PSD) model, grounded in psychological distance theory, maps four-domain signals (physical, social, cognitive, and informational) into a unified risk metric that gates entry to cognitive reasoning. An explicit Emotion node grounded in appraisal emotion theory is introduced into BDI, forming a novel Belief-Desire-Emotion-Intention (BDEI) pathway that couples threat appraisal directly to emotional arousal. Inverting the conventional LLM-as-decision-maker paradigm, PCP confines the LLM to parameter estimation for the Belief-to-Desire transition, restricting hallucinations to a single step and curbing their accumulation across steps. Experiments on Hurricane Sandy show PCP improves individual prediction accuracy by 10.68% over baselines, reduces peak count error to 7.07%.
articles.titleCn: 认知图谱与大型语言模型的交汇：用于恐慌情绪唤醒预测的BDEI认知路径
articles.abstractCn: 预测个体和集体恐慌情绪唤醒在表现出现之前的时机对于及时进行应急干预至关重要。现有方法包含认知元素，但它们都没有在唤醒过程的生成方向上对情绪进行建模，导致唤醒时机无法确定。我们认为，将预测建立在评估情绪理论的基础上是必要的，因为该理论在其自然生成方向上明确地建模了这一过程，但必须解决三个问题。(1) 评估理论认为情绪源于对多个威胁维度的同步评估，然而以往的研究并未将这些输入融合为风险感知；(2) 现有模型在相反的行为桥接方向上进行训练，仅仅将情绪作为行为的后验相关变量进行恢复；(3) 采用大型语言模型作为主要决策者但忽视其输出脆弱性和易产生幻觉的问题。我们引入了恐慌认知路径（PanicCognitivePath，PCP）来解决这三个问题。基于心理距离理论的心理安全距离（Psychological Safety Distance，PSD）模型将四个域的信号（物理、社会、认知和信息）映射为统一的风险指标，该指标控制着进入认知推理的入口。基于评估情绪理论，我们引入了一个明确的情绪节点到BDI模型中，形成了一种新的信念-欲望-情绪-意图（Belief-Desire-Emotion-Intention，BDEI）路径，将威胁评估直接与情绪唤醒联系起来。颠覆了传统的“大型语言模型作为决策者”范式，PCP将大型语言模型限制在信念到欲望转变的参数估计中，将幻觉限制为单步操作，并控制了其跨步骤的累积。在飓风桑迪的实验表明，PCP比基线提高了10.68%的个体预测准确率，并将峰值计数误差降低至7.07%。

articles.title: Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens
articles.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforce each other to evade detection. To alleviate these challenges, we propose ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a training-free framework that operates within the embedding space. ASRD explicitly decouples the decoding context into trusted \textit{Anchor Tokens}, which are identified via temporal consistency, and uncertain candidates. Leveraging a dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation, which injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into masked positions to implicitly rectify attention toward the reliable global skeleton; and (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification, which applies orthogonal perturbations to uncertain candidate tokens, destabilizing and remasking errors driven by fragile local consensus. Extensive experiments on math and coding benchmarks demonstrate that ASRD outperforms recent remasking baselines, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 6.4\% while accelerating inference throughput by up to 7.2$\times$.The code is available at https://github.com/preordinary/ASRD.
articles.titleCn: 遵循潜在路线图：使用锚点标记导航扩散式大语言模型的可撤销解码
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）为并行生成提供了有前景的途径，但在解码速度和质量之间面临权衡。虽然可撤销解码策略通过验证和重新掩码标记来尝试减轻错误，但它们通常在混合质量的环境下运行。这导致了两个关键问题：\textit{错误传播}，即新标记从错误上下文中吸收有害信息；以及\textit{局部错误强化}，即错误相互强化以逃避检测。为缓解这些挑战，我们提出了ASRD（锚点监督可撤销解码），这是一个无需训练的框架，在嵌入空间中运行。ASRD明确地将解码上下文解耦为可信的\textit{锚点标记}（通过时间一致性识别）和不确定候选。利用动态锚点标记缓存，我们引入了两种互补机制：(1) 锚点引导生成，将熵加权锚点信号注入掩码位置，以隐式纠正注意力指向可靠的全球骨架；(2) 锚点扰动验证，对不确定候选标记应用正交扰动，破坏并重新掩码由脆弱局部共识驱动的错误。在数学和编码基准测试中的大量实验表明，ASRD优于最近的可撤销掩码基线，在准确率上提升了高达6.4%，同时将推理吞吐量加速了高达7.2倍。代码可在https://github.com/preordinary/ASRD获取。

articles.title: Delayed Verification Destabilizes Multi-Agent LLM Belief: Instability Thresholds and Optimal Corrector Placement
articles.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems often rely on verifier and critic agents to suppress hallucinations, but verification is delayed. During this delay, false claims can propagate through the agent network. We model this process as delayed consensus on a graph with grounded corrector nodes. Spectral decomposition by the grounded Laplacian yields a closed-form stability threshold for the verification dose: correction that is too strong or too delayed can turn consensus into oscillation. The most unstable regime occurs when the communication and verification delays coincide; for delay two, the threshold is the inverse golden ratio. The same framework gives a supermodular placement objective and a greedy (1-1/e)-approximation rule for assigning a limited corrector budget to influential nodes. Experiments across five open models confirm the predicted dose-delay oscillations. By contrast, grounded factual answering makes truth an absorbing boundary and eliminates the effect, suggesting that the instability is specific to signed-belief tasks while grounded verification remains stabilizing
articles.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 3 numbered tables. Revised stability and placement claims; corrected delay indexing and empirical interpretation. Added a 400-question factual study with versioned scoring and uncertainty analysis. Clarified proofs and limitations. Code and data: https://github.com/YehudaItkin/delayed-verification-llm
articles.titleCn: 延迟验证破坏多智能体LLM信念：不稳定性阈值与最优纠正器放置
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）系统通常依赖验证器和评论者智能体来抑制幻觉，但验证过程存在延迟。在此期间，错误声明可以通过智能体网络传播。我们将此过程建模为基于正确节点（grounded corrector nodes）的图上的延迟共识。由接地拉普拉斯矩阵（grounded Laplacian）进行的谱分解给出了验证剂量的闭式稳定性阈值：过强或过迟的纠正会使共识转变为振荡。最不稳定的状况发生在通信延迟和验证延迟重合时；对于延迟二，阈值是黄金比的倒数。相同的框架给出了一个超模放置目标，以及为有影响力的节点分配有限纠正预算的贪婪（1-1/e）近似规则。跨五个公开模型的实验证实了预测的剂量-延迟振荡。相比之下，接地事实回答使真相成为吸收边界并消除了这种效应，表明这种不稳定性是针对有符号信念任务特有的，而接地验证仍然具有稳定作用。

articles.title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but prompt groups with identical rollout rewards consume generation budget without effective learning signals. Pre-rollout prompt selection can reduce this waste by screening prompts before rollout generation. However, existing pre-rollout methods struggle to balance exploitation and exploration: repeatedly exploiting historically informative prompts can narrow training coverage, whereas broader exploration can lower the fraction of informative prompts. To address these limitations, we introduce LEEPS, a Latent-Guided Explore--Exploit Prompt Sampler that adaptively balances the reuse of previously observed informative prompts with continued exploration of uncertain ones. LEEPS partitions candidates into exploit and explore portfolios and adaptively allocates rollout budget according to their recent non-trivial ratios. It further uses representation-space neighbors and historical rollout outcomes to prioritize uncertain prompts likely to yield non-zero reward variance, thereby making exploration more targeted without additional rollouts. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LEEPS achieves the highest average score at both model scales, with relative gains of 2.6\% and 3.7\% over the strongest baseline for Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 7B, respectively, and generally improves faster during the training process. It also achieves the highest average score across the three evaluated OOD general-reasoning benchmarks at both model scales and adds only about 2 seconds of online sampling overhead per training step. Code is available at https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS.
articles.titleCn: LEEPS：用于大型语言模型高效RLVR的潜在引导探索-利用提示采样
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）提升了大型语言模型的推理能力，但具有相同部署奖励的提示组会消耗生成预算而缺乏有效的学习信号。部署前提示选择可以通过筛选提示来减少这种浪费。然而，现有的部署前方法难以平衡利用与探索：反复利用具有历史信息的提示会缩小训练覆盖范围，而更广泛的探索会降低信息提示的比例。为解决这些限制，我们引入了LEEPS，一种基于潜在引导的探索-利用提示采样器，它能自适应地平衡先前观察到的信息提示的重用与对不确定提示的持续探索。LEEPS将候选提示划分为利用和探索组合，并根据它们最近的非平凡比例自适应分配部署预算。它进一步利用表示空间邻居和历史部署结果来优先级不确定的提示，这些提示可能产生非零奖励方差，从而在不增加额外部署的情况下使探索更具针对性。在六个数学推理基准测试中，LEEPS在两种模型规模下均取得了最高的平均分数，相对于最强的基线，在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B和7B上分别提高了2.6%和3.7%的相对增益，并且在训练过程中通常进步更快。它还在三种评估的OOD泛化推理基准测试中在两种模型规模下均取得了最高的平均分数，并且每步训练仅增加了约2秒的在线采样开销。代码可在https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS获取。

articles.title: RT-SEMamba: Real-Time Speech Enhancement Mamba via Progressive Knowledge Distillation
articles.abstract: We present RT-SEMamba, a fully causal speech enhancement (SE) model built upon causal time-frequency Mamba blocks. Unlike Transformer-based architectures that rely on a growing key-value cache, Mamba propagates a fixed-size recurrent state per layer, enabling memory- and bandwidth-efficient long-form inference. We further introduce a progressive knowledge distillation (KD) strategy that compresses an 8-layer teacher into a shallow 1-layer student by jointly distilling complex spectral outputs and intermediate representations. On Voicebank-DEMAND, the 8-layer RT-SEMamba achieves 3.32 PESQ with a 25 ms algorithmic latency constraint, and the distilled 1-layer student improves over a naive 1-layer baseline from 3.06 to 3.18 PESQ while preserving the same steady-state RTF, delivering a 2.64x speedup over the teacher. These results demonstrate that state-space models with progressive KD provide a competitive quality-latency trade-off for real-time SE.
articles.titleCn: RT-SEMamba：基于渐进式知识蒸馏的实时语音增强Mamba
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了RT-SEMamba，一种基于因果时频Mamba模块的全因果语音增强（SE）模型。与依赖不断增长的键值缓存的基于Transformer的架构不同，Mamba每层传播固定大小的循环状态，从而实现内存和带宽高效的长期推理。我们进一步引入了一种渐进式知识蒸馏（KD）策略，通过联合蒸馏复杂的频谱输出和中间表示，将8层教师模型压缩为浅层1层学生模型。在Voicebank-DEMAND上，8层RT-SEMamba在25毫秒算法延迟约束下实现了3.32 PESQ，蒸馏后的1层学生模型在3.06的朴素1层基线上的性能提升至3.18 PESQ，同时保持相同的稳态RTF，相比教师模型实现了2.64倍的加速。这些结果表明，具有渐进式KD的状态空间模型为实时SE提供了具有竞争力的质量-延迟权衡。

articles.title: TurnBench: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Turn-Taking Dynamics in Spoken Dialogue
articles.abstract: Speakers in natural conversation take turns speaking and listening, deciding in real time when to take, hold, or yield the floor. However, turn-taking evaluation remains limited due to the lack of a consistent, linguistically grounded evaluation protocol and hand-annotated data covering diverse conversation types. To address this, we present TurnBench, a multi-domain benchmark that pairs a 30-hour, hand-labeled corpus of dyadic human conversation with a standardized evaluation protocol for end-of-turn and interruption detection. We set conversation type as a controllable experimental variable, covering six distinct interaction styles, and triple-annotate each conversation. Benchmarking 14 heterogeneous turn-taking systems, we find end-of-turn recall stable across types, while interruption false positives are strongly type-dependent and concentrated in backchannel-dense interaction styles. Although in smooth floor transfers human listeners begin speaking a median 151 ms before the current turn ends, no current system performs equivalently without incurring excessive false positives. We release our corpus, a 104-hour training set, and a public leaderboard with an interactive dataset viewer at https://turnbench.sesame.com.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. v2: camera-ready version
articles.titleCn: TurnBench：一个用于口语对话中轮流动态的多领域基准
articles.abstractCn: 在自然对话中，说话者和听话者轮流发言和倾听，实时决定何时开始、持续或放弃发言权。然而，由于缺乏一套统一、基于语言的评估协议和涵盖多种对话类型的标注数据，对话轮流评估仍然受限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TurnBench，一个跨领域的基准测试平台，它将一个30小时的二人对话人工标注语料库与一套标准化的评估协议相结合，用于检测发言结束和打断。我们将对话类型设为可控的实验变量，涵盖了六种不同的互动风格，并对每场对话进行三重标注。通过测试14种异构的对话轮流系统，我们发现发言结束的召回率在不同类型中保持稳定，而打断的误报率则强烈依赖于对话类型，并集中在高后置反馈互动风格中。尽管在流畅的发言权转移过程中，人类听众在当前发言结束前中位数提前151毫秒开始发言，但当前没有系统能在不产生过多误报的情况下实现同等效果。我们发布了我们的语料库，一个104小时的训练集，以及一个带有交互式数据集查看器的公共排行榜，网址为https://turnbench.sesame.com。

articles.title: Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
articles.abstract: Assistants built on large language models are expected to write in their users' own voice. Most systems summarise the user's preferences and include the summary in the prompt. This is the wrong way round. Preferences are only the surface of a person and change with the task, while the underlying personality stays the same, so storing preferences alone means relearning the user afresh whenever the task changes. This paper makes four contributions. First, we describe an effect we call personality seepage: the wording of a prompt carries traces of the writer's personality, which the assistant copies without knowing the writer. Second, we propose the Atomic User Model (AUM), a readable profile with a stable identity core surrounded by four layers covering psychological, cognitive, experiential, behavioral, and social details, plus notes on inner conflict and authenticity. Third, instead of inserting the entire profile, we use AUM as a searchable index, in which a task classifier, a selection step, and a budgeted retriever pass along only a few relevant fields. Fourth, we test the pipeline with 16 simulated users, 6 style-sensitive tasks, and 3 seeds. Eight retrieved fields matched the writing quality of the whole profile, while using only 23 percent of the context (211 tokens instead of 915). They scored 0.24 points higher than a plain preference note on a five-point scale. Accuracy in picking a user's own writing from four samples rose from 14.9 to 42.7 percent, where guessing gives 25 percent. Four pre-registered controls showed no effect, so the gain comes from the profile's structure rather than the search method. Personalization helps most for the users for whom a generic assistant imitates them the worst.
articles.titleCn: 构建面向人格感知的大型语言模型交互的原子用户模型
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型的助手被期望使用其用户自己的声音进行写作。大多数系统总结用户的偏好并将总结包含在提示中。这是错误的方法。偏好只是一个人的表面，会随着任务的变化而变化，而潜在的人格保持不变，因此仅存储偏好意味着每当任务变化时都需要重新学习用户。本文提出了四个贡献。首先，我们描述了一种我们称为人格渗透的现象：提示的措辞带有作者的个性痕迹，助手在不知情的情况下复制了这些痕迹。其次，我们提出了原子用户模型（AUM），这是一个具有稳定身份核心的可读档案，其周围有四个层次，涵盖心理、认知、经验、行为和社会细节，以及关于内心冲突和真实性的注释。第三，我们不是插入整个档案，而是将AUM用作一个可搜索的索引，其中任务分类器、选择步骤和预算检索器仅传递少数几个相关字段。第四，我们使用16个模拟用户、6个对风格敏感的任务和3个种子测试了该流程。八个检索字段匹配了整个档案的写作质量，而仅使用了23%的上下文（211个标记而不是915个）。在五分制中，他们的得分比纯偏好注释高0.24分。从四个样本中选择用户自己写作的准确率从14.9%提高到42.7%，而猜测的准确率为25%。四个预先注册的控制实验显示没有效果，因此这种提升来自档案的结构，而不是搜索方法。个性化对那些通用助手模仿得最差的用户最有帮助。

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Retrievers for Polish and European Languages
articles.abstract: Dense retrieval systems increasingly rely on multi-billion-parameter language models, whose memory and computational requirements make large-scale indexing, frequent corpus updates, and low-latency serving costly. We present a three-stage training pipeline for developing compact and efficient retrievers that remain competitive with substantially larger models. The pipeline combines cross-lingual alignment, relational knowledge distillation, and contrastive fine-tuning. It requires no original ground-truth relevance labels, relying exclusively on supervision generated by strong embedding models and rerankers utilised as teachers. Using this pipeline, we develop PolDense and EuroDense, both supporting contexts of up to 8,192 tokens. PolDense is a family of six Polish retrievers ranging from 17M to 1B parameters. EuroDense is a 435M-parameter retriever supporting nine European languages. We conduct an extensive evaluation covering 41 Polish and 150 multilingual retrieval tasks. The results demonstrate strong quality-efficiency trade-offs. PolDense-1B outperforms the evaluated retrievers with up to 9B parameters, while the PolDense family forms the Pareto frontier across model sizes. Among the evaluated models below 1B parameters, EuroDense ranks first in both task-averaged and language-averaged performance and leads in seven of nine languages. We release all models publicly.
articles.titleCn: 面向波兰语和欧洲语言的参数高效检索器
articles.abstractCn: 密集检索系统越来越依赖具有数十亿参数的语言模型，但其内存和计算需求使得大规模索引、频繁语料库更新和低延迟服务变得昂贵。我们提出了一种三阶段训练流程，用于开发紧凑高效的检索器，使其在与远超其规模的模型竞争中保持优势。该流程结合了跨语言对齐、关系知识蒸馏和对比微调。它无需原始的相关性真实标签，完全依赖于由强大的嵌入模型和用作教师的重新排序器产生的监督。利用该流程，我们开发了PolDense和EuroDense，两者均支持高达8192个token的上下文。PolDense是一系列包含六个波兰检索器，参数范围从1700万到10亿。EuroDense是一个4.35亿参数的检索器，支持九种欧洲语言。我们进行了广泛的评估，涵盖41项波兰和150项多语言检索任务。结果表明，在质量与效率的权衡上表现出色。PolDense-1B在参数高达90亿的检索器中表现最佳，而PolDense系列在所有模型规模中都构成了帕累托前沿。在参数低于10亿的评估模型中，EuroDense在任务平均和语言平均性能中均排名第一，并在九种语言中的七种语言中领先。我们公开发布了所有模型。

articles.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging
articles.abstract: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.
articles.titleCn: 社交消息中的零样本叙事检测
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在识别和分类社交信息中隐藏叙事方面的零样本能力。我们的研究假设是，LLMs广泛的环境知识使其能够以更深层、更具实践性的水平解读信息，超越基本情感或主题分析。在Dipromats和SemEval数据集上的实验表明，向模型提供人类编写的叙事描述能够显著提高性能，而无需训练样本。相比之下，自动生成的描述或使用少量示例（少样本）往往会因框架的细微变化而降低准确性。研究还发现，集成方法，特别是多数投票，增强了鲁棒性，而更大的模型表现最佳，同时对提示变化也不敏感。这些发现证实了LLMs能够在零样本设置下有效检测策略性叙事，并且当结合简单的集成和人类编写的描述时，它们可以媲美监督系统，为叙事检测提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，尤其是在大多数领域没有训练数据的情况下。

articles.title: Vroom-Vroom at SHROOM-Visions: A Multi-Judge Committee for Detecting Hallucinated Spans in Vision-Language Outputs
articles.abstract: This paper describes our submission to the SHROOM-Visions shared task on detecting and classifying hallucinated character spans in vision-language model outputs across four languages. We employ several fine-tuned vision-language models as independent annotators and combine their span predictions through character-level majority voting, and additionally explore activation probes. The approach ranks first in three of four languages and places on the podium in every language and metric. Our analysis indicates that disagreement among diverse models tracks disagreement among human annotators.
articles.comment: Accepted to UncertaiNLP 2026 @ EMNLP. SHROOM-Visions 2026 shared task system description
articles.titleCn: SHROOM-Visions中的轰隆轰隆：用于检测视觉语言输出中幻觉片段的多评委委员会
articles.abstractCn: 本文描述了我们针对SHROOM-Visions共享任务提交的成果，该任务旨在检测和分类视觉语言模型输出中四种语言下的幻觉字符片段。我们采用多个经过微调的视觉语言模型作为独立的标注者，并通过字符级多数投票结合它们的片段预测，此外还探索了激活探针。该方法在四种语言的其中三种中排名第一，并在所有语言和指标中都位列前三。我们的分析表明，不同模型之间的分歧与人类标注者之间的分歧相一致。

articles.title: ASPIRE: Asynchronous Batched Self-Speculative Decoding for Long-Context LLM Inference
articles.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by attention, whose repeated KV-cache reads make decoding memory-bound. Self-speculative decoding alleviates this by drafting tokens with sparse attention and verifying them with full attention, but existing batched methods remain synchronized: all requests in a batch share a single draft-verify schedule, even though the optimal draft length varies widely across requests and changes dynamically within each request. We propose ASPIRE, a non-synchronized batched self-speculative decoding framework built on three components. First, a unified mixed forward allows drafting and verifying requests to coexist in the same batched forward pass, removing the need for global draft-verify phases. Second, a lightweight online speculation scheduler uses per-request acceptance-rate estimates and a batch-aware cost model to let each request independently choose when to verify. Third, an intra-draft refresh layer performs full attention at a single designated layer during drafting, updating the sparse context at every draft step to reduce staleness during drafting. Across three models and five reasoning and long-context benchmarks, ASPIRE achieves $1.70$-$4.58\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over autoregressive baselines and improves average speedup by approximately $27\%$ over the strongest prior self-speculative baselines.
articles.titleCn: ASPIRE：用于长上下文LLM推理的异步批处理自推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文大语言模型推理受限于注意力机制，其重复的KV缓存读取导致解码过程受内存限制。自推测解码通过稀疏注意力生成token并使用全注意力验证来缓解这一问题，但现有的批量方法仍保持同步：同一批次中的所有请求共享一个单一的生成-验证调度，尽管最佳生成长度在不同请求间差异巨大，且在每个请求内部动态变化。我们提出了ASPIRE，一个基于三个组件的非同步批量自推测解码框架。首先，统一的混合前向传播允许生成和验证请求共存于同一批量前向传播中，消除了对全局生成-验证阶段的需求。其次，轻量级在线推测调度器利用每个请求的接受率估计和批次感知成本模型，让每个请求独立选择验证时机。第三，生成过程中的内部刷新层在指定层进行全注意力计算，并在每个生成步骤更新稀疏上下文，以减少生成过程中的陈旧性。在三个模型和五个推理及长上下文基准测试中，ASPIRE相较于自回归基线解码吞吐量提升1.70-4.58倍，相较于最强的先前自推测基线平均加速提升约27%。

articles.title: TACTICS: Taxonomy-Aware Intelligent Corpus Sampling for Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Large-scale machine-translation (MT) systems are typically evaluated on random samples from a corpus whose distributional composition is an artifact of how it was assembled. Such a sample inherits the phenomena the collection happens to contain rather than the full space a system must handle, spanning rule-governed conventions (terminology, punctuation, currency formatting) and context-dependent phenomena (tone, honorifics, document-level coherence), and thus provides no coverage guarantee for assessing robustness. We propose TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling), which recasts coverage as an explicit objective. TACTICS induces a hierarchical taxonomy from a locale style guide, classifies segments against it, and selects a fixed-budget subset jointly optimizing coverage of rare categories, document-level coherence, and distributional fidelity to the full corpus. Applied to MT evaluation across four translation directions, TACTICS improves coverage of rare categories over lexical and embedding-based selection. By targeting the phenomena that separate systems, TACTICS makes a fixed evaluation budget go further, recovering the true system ranking from far fewer segments than random sampling wherever a real quality gap exists and never signaling a difference where none exists.
articles.comment: Accepted at The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026 (WMT2026)
articles.titleCn: 策略：基于分类学的智能语料库采样用于机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 大规模机器翻译（MT）系统通常在语料库的随机样本上进行评估，而语料库的分布性组成是其在组装过程中形成的一种人为产物。这样的样本继承了集合中偶然包含的现象，而非系统必须处理的完整空间，后者涵盖了受规则约束的惯例（术语、标点、货币格式）和依赖上下文的现象（语气、敬语、文档级连贯性），因此无法为评估鲁棒性提供覆盖率保证。我们提出了TACTICS（基于分类的覆盖率优化智能语料库采样），将覆盖率重新定义为明确的目标。TACTICS从地区风格指南中诱导出分层分类体系，对片段进行分类，并选择一个固定预算的子集，该子集联合优化了稀有类别的覆盖率、文档级连贯性以及对完整语料库分布的忠实度。应用于四个翻译方向的MT评估，TACTICS在基于词汇和嵌入的选择方法上，显著提高了稀有类别的覆盖率。通过针对区分系统的现象，TACTICS使固定评估预算发挥更大作用，在存在真实质量差距的地方，从远少于随机采样的片段数量中恢复出真实的系统排名，并且永远不会在不存在差异的地方标示出差异。

articles.title: Encoder Awakening via Adapters: Effective Domain-Adaptive Fine-tuning of Speech-LLMs
articles.abstract: Speech Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs), typically built from a pre-trained speech encoder, a modality projector, and an LLM fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), have shown strong Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance on general-domain speech. However, adapting them to domain-shifted speech, such as child or dialectal speech, remains challenging under limited target-domain data. Given the dominant role of the LLM in Speech-LLMs, with cross-entropy loss applied only at the LLM output, the speech encoder may receive insufficient adaptation to new acoustic conditions. In this paper, we propose Encoder Awakening via Adapters (EAVA), a simple yet effective domain-adaptive fine-tuning method for Speech-LLM-based ASR. First, lightweight adapters are inserted into each encoder layer and trained exclusively, enabling target-domain acoustic knowledge to be incorporated into the encoder while preserving its pre-trained knowledge. Second, the full model is jointly fine-tuned on the target domain with LoRA applied to the LLM. Experiments on three domain-shifted ASR datasets, covering child and dialectal speech, show that EAVA consistently outperforms vanilla fine-tuning and other baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.
articles.titleCn: 通过适配器唤醒编码器：语音LLM的有效域自适应微调
articles.abstractCn: 基于预训练语音编码器、模态投影器以及使用低秩适配器（LoRA）微调的大型语言模型（LLM）的语音大型语言模型（Speech-LLMs），在通用领域语音上展现了强大的自动语音识别（ASR）性能。然而，在目标领域数据有限的情况下，将它们应用于领域偏移的语音（如儿童语音或方言语音）仍然具有挑战性。鉴于LLM在Speech-LLMs中起主导作用，且交叉熵损失仅在LLM输出处应用，语音编码器可能无法充分适应新的声学条件。在本文中，我们提出了通过适配器唤醒编码器（EAVA），一种简单而有效的针对Speech-LLM-based ASR的领域自适应微调方法。首先，将轻量级适配器插入每个编码器层并单独训练，使目标领域声学知识能够融入编码器，同时保留其预训练知识。其次，对整个模型在目标领域上进行联合微调，并将LoRA应用于LLM。在涵盖儿童语音和方言语音的三个领域偏移ASR数据集上的实验表明，EAVA始终优于纯微调和其它基线，实现了新的最先进性能。

articles.title: Modeling the Developmental Shift in Telicity Acquisition
articles.abstract: Acquiring telicity, which is the distinction between bounded (e.g., ate an apple) and unbounded (e.g., ate apples) events, requires first language (L1) learners to map surface-level and semantic cues to abstract event structures, but the computational trajectory of this mapping is not well understood. We introduce a Difference in Surprisal method that uses GPT2 token surprisal over paired temporal adverbial diagnostics (in an hour versus for an hour) to automatically label telicity across English CHILDES corpora, validated against expert linguist judgments. Using these labels, we train diagnostic logistic regression classifiers on 12 syntactic and lexical semantic features to compare how child speech and child-directed speech encode telicity. The two models diverge: the child model reaches near perfect accuracy through a single deterministic cue, the presence of a post-verbal determiner, while the adult model relies more heavily on verb class and other lexical semantic features, with the determiner cue neutralized. This trajectory supports Syntactic Bootstrapping: learners first exploit high-frequency structural cues as a scaffold to bootstrap, before developing fully compositional, verb-based event structures.
articles.titleCn: 建模 telicity 掌握的发展性转变
articles.abstractCn: 习得 telicity（即区分有界事件，如“ate an apple”，和无界事件，如“ate apples”的能力）要求第一语言（L1）学习者将表层和语义线索映射到抽象的事件结构上，但这种映射的计算过程尚不清楚。我们引入了一种基于意外性差异（Difference in Surprisal）的方法，该方法利用 GPT2 令牌意外性对成对的时间副词诊断（“in an hour”与“for an hour”）进行自动标注英语 CHILDES 语料库中的 telicity，并通过专家语言学家判断进行验证。利用这些标签，我们在 12 个句法和词汇语义特征上训练诊断逻辑回归分类器，以比较儿童语言和儿童导向语言如何编码 telicity。这两个模型存在差异：儿童模型通过单一的确定性线索——动词后的限定词——即可达到接近完美的准确率，而成人模型则更依赖于动词类别和其他词汇语义特征，限定词线索被中性化。这一轨迹支持句法启动（Syntactic Bootstrapping）理论：学习者首先利用高频结构线索作为脚手架进行启动，然后才发展出完全组合的、基于动词的事件结构。

articles.title: A Calibrated Instrument for Measuring How Inference Optimizations Affect Output Quality
articles.abstract: Large language model optimization is an active research area, spanning quantization of model weights, early-exit methods for skipping layers, and speculative decoding. Each track uses its own quality measures, typically an idiosyncratic benchmark score. Few approach the measurement precision required by other scientific disciplines. We propose a rigorous methodology for measuring output quality, suitable for cross-system and cross-technique comparison. We score outputs with an LLM as a judge, but calibrate the judge formally: we compare its scores on two ordinary runs of a model given the same prompts, verifying that it shows no systematic preference between statistically equivalent outputs and measuring its per-sample noise. Each design also includes a 'null' condition, provably identical in distribution to the unmodified model, whose measured difference must be zero. With this one instrument we measure several acceleration techniques on the same prompts, so their quality costs can be compared. Perceived quality proves highly dependent on the domain of discourse. A 4-bit model was indistinguishable from its 16-bit original down to our design's +/-0.3-point resolution, in English prose and Chinese alike. At 3-bit precision the same prompts lost 0.5 points in English prose, 0.9 in Chinese, and 1.1 on multi-step math; early exit that cost 0.7 points on prose cost 2.5 on math, cutting correctly solved problems from 19 of 27 to 6. The pattern held for models from Alibaba and from Meta, but not its magnitude: the same quantizer cost Meta's model 1.8 points where it cost Alibaba's 0.7. A model's certainty about a token predicts how likely it is to differ from the full model's choice, but not how much that difference affects judged quality, so acceptance rules relying on certainty cannot distinguish errors that matter from errors that don't.
articles.comment: 23 Pages. 6 tables in main text,5 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at https://github.com/jerrykaplan/Calibrated-Instrument
articles.titleCn: 一种用于测量推理优化如何影响输出质量的校准仪器
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型优化是一个活跃的研究领域，涵盖了模型权重的量化、跳过层的早期退出方法以及推测性解码。每个方向都使用其自身的质量度量标准，通常是一个独特的基准分数。很少有方法达到其他科学学科所需的测量精度。我们提出了一种严格的输出质量测量方法，适用于跨系统和跨技术的比较。我们使用一个大型语言模型作为裁判来评分输出，但正式校准裁判：我们将它在模型两次普通运行中针对相同提示的评分进行比较，验证它不会在统计上等效的输出之间表现出系统性偏好，并测量其每一样本的噪声。每个设计还包括一个“零”条件，可证明其分布与未修改的模型完全相同，其测量差异必须为零。使用这一工具，我们在相同的提示下测量了几种加速技术，以便比较它们的质量成本。感知质量被证明高度依赖于讨论的领域。在英语散文和中文中，4位模型的输出与16位原始模型在±0.3分的分辨率下无法区分。在3位精度下，相同的提示在英语散文中损失了0.5分，在中文中损失了0.9分，在多步数学中损失了1.1分；在散文中损失0.7分的早期退出在数学中损失了2.5分，将正确解决的数学问题从27个中的19个减少到6个。这一模式适用于来自阿里巴巴和Meta的模型，但其幅度并不相同：相同的量化器对Meta模型的损失为1.8分，而对阿里巴巴模型的损失为0.7分。一个模型对某个标记的确定性可以预测它与完整模型选择的差异的可能性，但不能预测这种差异对评判质量的影响程度，因此依赖确定性的接受规则无法区分重要错误与不重要错误。

articles.title: Gaze as Evidence for Common Grounding: A Cross-Corpus Analysis of MapTask and MUNDEX
articles.abstract: In collaborative tasks with asymmetric information, participants coordinate their understanding through interaction. We ask whether gaze provides evidence about grounding across two such tasks. Working from discrete behavioral annotations, we map HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991) and MUNDEX (Türk et al., 2023) into a shared partner/task/away vocabulary and compute gaze features around task-relevant dialogue units. In both corpora, aligned reference interpretations (MapTask) and UND (understood) judgments (MUNDEX) are associated with more task-directed gaze and with less partner-directed gaze, lower gaze entropy, and fewer gaze transitions. The associations are clearest for the participant leading the task: in giver-produced references, and in explainer judgments, which also co-vary with the explainee's gaze. In same-speaker MapTask reference chains, the speaker's gaze entropy is lower at the mention where a previously non-aligned referent becomes aligned. The best gaze feature groups improve modestly over controls under grouped cross-validation: temporal features in MapTask and raw proportions in MUNDEX. Because effects are small and several weaken when recurring participants rather than dialogues are the unit of inference, we treat gaze as one contributing cue to grounding, to be interpreted alongside task and dialogue context.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 17 tables, 2 figures; accepted to the MINT workshop at EMNLP 2026 (oral presentation)
articles.titleCn: 作为共同基础的证据：对MapTask和MUNDEX的跨语料库分析
articles.abstractCn: 在信息不对称的协作任务中，参与者通过互动协调彼此的理解。我们探究了注视是否能为两种此类任务中的意涵建立提供证据。基于离散的行为标注，我们将HCRC MapTask（Anderson等人，1991）和MUNDEX（Türk等人，2023）映射到一个共享的伙伴/任务/远离词汇，并计算任务相关对话单元周围的注视特征。在两个语料库中，对齐的参考解释（MapTask）和UND（理解）判断（MUNDEX）都与更多任务导向的注视、更少的伙伴导向的注视、更低的注视熵以及更少的注视转换相关联。这些关联在主导任务的参与者中最为明显：在给予者产生的参考中，以及在解释者的判断中，这些判断也与被解释者的注视共同变化。在同名说话者的MapTask参考链中，当先前未对齐的指称变得对齐时，说话者的注视熵更低。在分组交叉验证下，最佳注视特征组对对照组的改进微乎其微：MapTask中的时间特征和MUNDEX中的原始比例。由于效应较小，且当参与者而非对话成为推理单位时，多个效应会减弱，我们将注视视为意涵建立的一个贡献线索，需结合任务和对话背景进行解读。

articles.title: Correlation-Guided Encoder Selection for Multi-Encoder Large Audio-Language Models
articles.abstract: Multi-encoder fusion extends Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) beyond speech-centric recognition, but selecting encoders via intuition or exhaustive search often introduces redundant representations and inflates an already constrained compute budget. We propose CUES (Correlation-gUided Encoder Selection), a lightweight heuristic that estimates complementarity through task- and category-level Pearson correlations between encoders' performance profiles, scoring a candidate set from single-encoder evaluations alone--without fusion training during selection. Evaluated on the XARES-LLM benchmark with a frozen SmolLM2-135M backbone (LoRA-adapted) via five-fold cross-validation, CUES consistently identifies the same configuration per track from held-out development splits alone, without using test data for selection. For the broad Track~A suite, CUES selects a cross-family trio (Whisper-medium, mHuBERT-147, and Dasheng-base), achieving a 4.3% relative gain over Whisper-medium (0.771 vs. 0.739). For Track~B text generation, it re-anchors on a focused, speech-only pair (mHuBERT-147 and WavLM-base-plus) and actively abstains from adding a divergent encoder, outperforming mHuBERT-147 by 6.3% (0.589 vs. 0.554). Rather than a failure to scale, this divergence is consistent with a diversity--interference trade-off that CUES navigates per track from correlation signals alone: across the evaluated pool, added cross-family diversity tends toward an inverted-U on broad audio tasks but toward steady degradation on text generation, which favors a focused, speech-anchored set.
articles.titleCn: 基于相关性引导的编码器选择方法用于多编码器大型音频-语言模型
