articles.titleCn: 用于招聘的多阶段大型语言模型管道中的制造缓解：提示护栏和人工检查点的实证评估
articles.abstractCn: 多阶段大型语言模型招聘流程（简历优化、面试问题生成、答案反馈）可能伪造资质、夸大资格并虚构经验。我们评估了两种缓解措施——提示护栏和人工介入（HITL）检查点——与完全自动化的基线相比。在受控实验中（10份合成简历 x 2份职位描述 x 3次重复 x 3种条件；共180次运行），基线（C1）在96.7%的输出中至少产生一项不支持的声明（平均每个输出6.80项发现）。提示护栏（C2）使发现密度降低了86%（从6.80降至0.92/输出），但50.0%的输出仍包含伪造内容，表明仅通过提示级缓解是不充分的。在简历优化后的检查点（C3）中，所有身份伪造均被消除，发现密度降低了59%（从6.88降至2.82/输出），项目级伪造率从96.7%降至75.0%（p=0.022），对职位描述嵌入陷阱要求的捕获率从47%降至2%（而护栏下为5%）。对多专业简历的探索性分析显示，随着专业间领域距离的增加，污染呈单调上升，表明职业转换者尤其易受影响。本研究中的审阅者捕获了所有明显的伪造，但轻微的资格删除和看似合理的声明在审阅中存活了约一半时间（去除率54.5%）。两种缓解措施均未降低交付质量：在两种条件下声明保留率均超过99%。这些干预措施是互补的：护栏以低成本消除未经提示的添加和资格膨胀，而检查点则提供近乎类别的保证，防止最严重的失败——虚构身份和职位描述诱饵声明。这些结果支持结合护栏和人工检查点的分层架构。一项使用新一代模型（基线伪造率为90.0%）的补充运行表明，仅靠模型进步无法解决此问题。

articles.title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts. Vanilla OPD applies this supervision uniformly across prompts, without checking whether the teacher is reliable for each prompt. Because reverse KL is mode-seeking, a confidently wrong teacher can induce a strong yet misleading update. Distributional proxies, such as entropy or teacher-student likelihood agreement, measure uncertainty or agreement but do not directly verify outcome correctness. We introduce Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation (TGOPD), built on the principle that teacher reliability should be verified at the prompt level before dense supervision is admitted. TGOPD estimates reliability from a small set of verifier-scored teacher probes and routes each prompt exclusively to dense OPD when the reliability check passes or to verifier-grounded GRPO otherwise. Across 4B and 35B students in mathematics, code, and instruction following, TGOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD in all six single-domain settings and achieves higher seven-benchmark averages at both scales under multi-domain training. By using otherwise-idle teacher capacity for reliability estimation, TGOPD also reduces teacher-side compute waste in asynchronous OPD, increasing teacher-node GPU utilization from 9.8% to 78.9% in the measured 4B single-domain run.
articles.titleCn: 在蒸馏前验证：用于在线策略蒸馏的提示级教师门控
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过冻结的教师模型在学生自己的推理过程中提供密集的标记级监督来加速后训练。原版OPD将这种监督均匀地应用于所有提示，而不会检查教师模型对每个提示是否可靠。由于反向KL散度是模式寻求的，一个自信错误的教师模型可能会诱导一个强烈但具有误导性的更新。分布代理，例如熵或教师-学生似然度一致性，可以测量不确定性或一致性，但并不能直接验证结果的正确性。我们引入了教师门控策略内蒸馏（TGOPD），其基于的原则是在接受密集监督之前，应在提示级别验证教师模型的可靠性。TGOPD通过一小部分验证者评分的教师探针来估计可靠性，并在通过可靠性检查时将每个提示专门路由到密集OPD，否则则路由到验证者基础的GRPO。在数学、代码和指令遵循的4B和35B学生模型中，TGOPD在所有六个单领域设置中均优于原版OPD，并在多领域训练下，在两个规模下均实现了更高的七基准平均性能。通过利用原本闲置的教师模型能力进行可靠性估计，TGOPD还减少了异步OPD中的教师端计算浪费，在测量的4B单领域运行中，将教师节点GPU利用率从9.8%提高到78.9%。

articles.title: Factors Influencing the Emergence of Dependency Length Minimization in Neural Agent Simulations
articles.abstract: Given various grammatical options, language users prefer the word order choice that reduces the overall length of syntactic dependencies, a principle known as dependency length minimization (DLM). The origins of this preference remain an open question, particularly whether it originates from constraints on efficient information processing. Computational simulations provide a powerful approach to identifying the factors influencing the emergence of linguistic phenomena. However, previous simulations of DLM have not examined realistic interaction contexts and have produced mixed results. The present study investigates the emergence of DLM in artificial languages using a recently proposed language learning and communication framework based on recurrent neural networks (RNNs). In this framework, agents are trained to speak and interpret artificial languages and then use these languages to communicate. Using this framework, we study the impact of several factors related to processing limitations in a communicative setting, such as noise during listening, limited speaker capacity, and incremental sentence processing. Our results reveal a complex interplay among these factors in shaping word order preferences in neural agents. Specifically, in the full meaning space, agents regularize toward a single dominant word order, while in the half meaning space they show a short-before-long preference that only aligns with DLM in verb-initial languages. A consistent DLM preference emerges only when agents are subject to incremental processing pressure. These findings suggest that limitations in human cognitive processing may indeed play a role in shaping DLM. Our findings provide insights into the conditions under which neural models replicate human-like preferences and highlight the challenges of designing emergent communication models that capture human cognitive biases in language processing.
articles.comment: This is a preprint version of the manuscript accepted for publication in Cognitive Science
articles.titleCn: 影响神经代理模拟中依赖长度最小化出现因素
articles.abstractCn: 在多种语法选项中，语言使用者倾向于选择能减少句法依赖整体长度的词序，这一原则被称为依赖长度最小化（DLM）。这种偏好来源仍是一个悬而未决的问题，特别是它是否源于对高效信息处理的限制。计算模拟为识别影响语言现象涌现的因素提供了有力方法。然而，以往的DLM模拟并未考察现实交互环境，且结果不一。本研究通过基于循环神经网络（RNNs）的近期提出的语言学习和交流框架，在人工语言中探究DLM的涌现。在该框架中，智能体被训练使用和解读人工语言，然后利用这些语言进行交流。借助该框架，我们研究了与交流环境中处理限制相关的多种因素的影响，例如听时噪声、说话者能力有限以及增量式句子处理。我们的结果表明，这些因素在塑造神经智能体的词序偏好中相互作用复杂。具体而言，在完整意义空间中，智能体会规范为单一主导词序，而在半意义空间中则表现出先短后长的偏好，这种偏好仅在动词起始语言中与DLM一致。只有当智能体受到增量式处理压力时，才会出现一致的DLM偏好。这些发现表明，人类认知处理的局限性确实可能在塑造DLM中发挥作用。我们的研究结果为神经模型在何种条件下复制人类偏好提供了见解，并突出了设计能捕捉人类语言处理认知偏见的涌现交流模型所面临的挑战。

articles.title: Causal Analysis and Mitigation of Spurious Onsets in Full-Duplex Speech LLMs
articles.abstract: Speech-to-speech LLMs like Moshi, and its derivative PersonaPlex, can listen and speak concurrently through full-duplex generation. However, they can begin speaking inappropriately during prolonged user silence: under digital-zero input, Moshi and PersonaPlex initiate speech in 30% and 27.5% of five-minute continuations, respectively. What causes this spurious speech? We investigate two hypotheses: either repeated sampling selects speech despite persistently low onset probabilities, or self-conditioning on nonspeech outputs causes an abrupt spike in onset probability. We find that, at every observed onset, speech probability spikes by over nine orders of magnitude in one 80-ms frame, supporting the latter hypothesis. Then, to suppress these onsets without blocking genuine responses, we ask a causal counterfactual question: is the model responding to user speech, or would its next-token distribution remain similar if the preceding user input were muted? Accordingly, we suppress onsets whose distributions change little under this intervention. Under realistic microphone noise, our method suppresses spurious onsets, while preserving genuine responses: one-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are 98.68% and 98.82% for Moshi, and 96.90% and 99.25% for PersonaPlex. Our inference-time method runs in real-time without retraining, with 95th-percentile decision time below 61 ms, within the 80-ms frame budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/KentoNishi/icassp27-spurious-onsets.
articles.titleCn: 全双工语音LLM中虚假启发的因果分析与缓解
articles.abstractCn: 像Moshi这样的语音到语音的大型语言模型，以及其衍生品PersonaPlex，可以通过全双工生成同时进行听和说。然而，在用户长时间沉默期间，它们可能会不恰当地开始说话：在数字零输入下，Moshi和PersonaPlex在五分钟的连续过程中分别有30%和27.5%的时间开始说话。是什么导致了这种虚假的语音？我们研究了两种假设：要么是重复采样尽管起始概率持续很低仍然选择了语音，要么是对非语音输出的自我条件导致了起始概率的急剧上升。我们发现，在每个观察到的起始点，语音概率在一个80毫秒的帧内急剧增加了超过九个数量级，支持了后一种假设。然后，为了抑制这些起始点而不阻塞真实的响应，我们提出了一个因果反事实问题：模型是在响应用户语音，还是如果之前的用户输入被静音，其下一个标记分布会保持相似？相应地，我们抑制了在这种干预下分布变化很小的起始点。在真实的麦克风噪声下，我们的方法抑制了虚假的起始点，同时保留了真实的响应：Moshi的一侧95%置信区间下限为98.68%和98.82%，PersonaPlex为96.90%和99.25%。我们的推理时方法无需重新训练即可实时运行，95%分位数决策时间低于61毫秒，在80毫秒的帧预算内。我们的代码可在https://github.com/KentoNishi/icassp27-spurious-onsets获取。

articles.title: How Humans and LLMs Read Gender into "Gender-Neutral" Physical Descriptions
articles.abstract: When foundation models describe people, recent work in AI fairness, accessibility, and ethics recommends avoiding inferred identity labels (e.g., "she", "his") in favor of seemingly "objective" physical descriptions (e.g., "short hair", "a defined jawline"). Yet whether such descriptive language achieves gender-neutral communication remains an open empirical question. To study this, we introduce GAPA (Gender Associations of Physical Attributes), a dataset of 316 common physical attributes drawn from diverse sources, paired with 14,706 gender-association ratings from 304 US-based annotators. Results show that physical descriptions carry structured and graded gender associations among readers, with more consistent and distinctive associations for women and men than for non-binary identities. Next, we evaluate 16 LLMs across model families, sizes, and post-training variants against human ratings. The models partially recover human associations but exhibit systematic alignment biases, including compressed rating distributions, weaker alignment for associations with men, and asymmetric abstention that disproportionately targets the non-binary category. Finally, we release the best-performing proxy model trained to predict humans' gender associations of descriptive language and demonstrate its utility through a sociolinguistic analysis of character descriptions in LitBank. Together, our findings provide the first empirical evidence that seemingly "objective" physical descriptions can retain systematic gender associations in human interpretation, and uncover systematic patterns of model-human misalignment. This challenges the assumption that replacing explicit gender labels with physical descriptions necessarily yields gender-neutral communication, and highlights downstream challenges in using such descriptions to communicate subjective identity categories in human-AI interaction.
articles.comment: The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Yingjia-Wan/GAPA, and the predictor model is released at https://huggingface.co/alisa-yingjia-wan/gapa-predictor-olmo2-7b
articles.titleCn: 人类和大型语言模型如何将性别解读入“性别中立”的物理描述中
articles.abstractCn: 当基础模型描述人类时，近期在人工智能公平性、可访问性和伦理方面的研究建议避免使用推断的身份标签（例如，“她”、“他的”），而倾向于使用看似“客观”的生理描述（例如，“短发”、“清晰的下颌线”）。然而，这种描述性语言是否能够实现性别中立的沟通仍然是一个悬而未决的经验性问题。为了研究这一点，我们引入了GAPA（生理特征的性别关联），这是一个包含316个常见生理特征的数据集，这些特征来自不同的来源，并配有来自304名美国标注者的14,706个性别关联评分。结果表明，生理描述在读者中带有结构化和等级化的性别关联，女性和男性的关联比非二元性别更为一致和独特。接下来，我们评估了16个LLM，涵盖不同的模型家族、规模和后训练变体，并与人类评分进行对比。这些模型在部分上恢复了人类的关联，但表现出系统性的对齐偏差，包括评分分布的压缩、对与男性关联的对齐较弱，以及不对称的回避行为，这种回避行为不成比例地针对非二元类别。最后，我们发布了一个表现最佳的代理模型，该模型经过训练以预测人类对描述性语言的性别关联，并通过对LitBank中角色描述的社会语言分析展示了其效用。总而言之，我们的研究首次提供了经验证据，证明看似“客观”的生理描述在人类解读中仍可能保留系统性的性别关联，并揭示了模型与人类之间系统性的错位模式。这挑战了用生理描述替代明确性别标签必然会产生性别中立沟通的假设，并突出了在人类-人工智能交互中使用此类描述来沟通主观身份类别时面临的下游挑战。

articles.title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.
articles.titleCn: 为什么预训练无法共享跨语言知识
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多种语言的处理和建模方面取得了显著进展。然而，与人类多语者不同，它们表现出令人惊讶的有限跨语言知识迁移能力。尽管这一局限性已被充分记录，但其多语言训练期间的起源仍不明确。我们预训练了参数规模为360M和7B的LLMs，并表明不良的跨语言知识泛化现象在预训练期间出现，并在标准干预措施下持续存在。为了找出其成因，我们采用了一种受控的双语预训练设置，该设置使用同一语言的两份副本，共享完全相同的文本和标记分割，但映射到不同的标记空间。我们发现，仅不同的标记就足以诱导知识分区，即使是在同一语言相同的副本之间也是如此，从而确立了不同的标记空间是跨语言知识泛化的基本障碍。基于这一理解，我们建议通过简单的逐词翻译将语言映射到一个共享的标记空间，并发现这显著提高了跨语言知识泛化能力，恢复了高达12.6%的母语学习效率——是基线的14倍。

articles.title: AUDITPLAN: Commit, Then Answer for Auditable Safety Alignment
articles.abstract: Safety tuning pipelines judge only the final answer, which makes it difficult to distinguish robust refusal from two undesirable shortcuts: blanket refusal on benign requests and polished but unfaithful safety rationales that do not actually constrain the answer. We propose AUDITPLAN, a single-model plan-then-answer approach where the model first emits a compact structured safety plan and then answers conditioned on it. The plan records a threat label, intended action, and explicit constraints, enabling machine-checkable auditing while remaining hidden from users at deployment. We train this behavior with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with FAITHGATE, a reward-gating objective that grants answer reward only when the safety plan is correct. This discourages safe-looking but unfaithful behavior and promotes tighter plan-answer coupling. Across Qwen backbones, AUDITPLAN improves both robustness and auditability: on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, FAITHGATE reduces ASR from 24.0% to 11.6%, LSR from 1.0% to 0.36%, and over-refusal from 11.0% to 2.0%, outperforming answer-only RL, free-form explanation, and weighted-sum structured rewards. Similar trends hold for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Larger-model confirmation runs on Qwen-3-4B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct preserve the same trend suggesting that explicit internal commitments can make safety alignment more faithful, robust, and auditable.
articles.titleCn: 审计计划：先执行，再对可审计安全一致性负责
articles.abstractCn: 安全调优流程仅评判最终答案，这使得区分鲁棒性拒绝与两种不良捷径变得困难：对良性请求的统一直拒，以及经过修饰但缺乏约束力的安全理由，这些理由并未真正限制答案。我们提出了AUDITPLAN，这是一种单模型计划-回答方法，其中模型首先发出一个紧凑的结构化安全计划，然后基于该计划进行回答。该计划记录威胁标签、预期行动和显式约束，既能实现机器可检查的审计，又能在使用部署时对用户隐藏。我们通过监督微调训练这种行为，然后使用FAITHGATE进行强化学习，FAITHGATE是一种奖励门控目标，仅在安全计划正确时才给予答案奖励。这抑制了看似安全但缺乏约束力的行为，并促进了计划与答案的紧密耦合。在Qwen主干网络上，AUDITPLAN提高了鲁棒性和可审计性：在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，FAITHGATE将ASR从24.0%降至11.6%，LSR从1.0%降至0.36%，过度拒绝从11.0%降至2.0%，优于仅回答的强化学习、自由形式解释和加权结构化奖励。Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上呈现出类似的趋势。在Qwen-3-4B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的更大模型确认运行中保留了相同趋势，表明明确的内部承诺可以使安全对齐更加忠实、鲁棒和可审计。

articles.title: Riemannian--Lorentz Fusion of Vision Transformers and State-Space Models
articles.abstract: Scaling deep learning faces critical bottlenecks: data exhaustion, exponential training costs, and resource concentration. Model merging combines pre-trained checkpoints without gradient descent, offering orders-of-magnitude savings versus retraining. Combining independently trained vision models is difficult when their architectures and parameter shapes differ. Existing weight-space merging methods generally assume aligned, shape-compatible checkpoints, whereas a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a state-space model (SSM) implement token mixing with different operators. We study a hybrid Heterogeneous merging setting that retains both architectures while aligning parameter groups by semantic role. Our proposed Riemannian--Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF) method projects aligned groups to common coordinates, lifts selected coordinates to the Lorentz hyperboloid model of hyperbolic space, computes a regularized geodesic barycenter, and decodes the result into the two branches. A learned gate then combines branch logits for each input. Component groups use fixed curvature values, with normalization parameters treated as Euclidean. In the results available in this manuscript, the fine-tuned system obtains 82.37\% on CIFAR-10, 75.04\% on Oxford-IIIT Pet, and 78.58\% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K; the corresponding best-parent accuracies are 76.54\%, 71.42\%, and 76.42\%. On ImageNet-1K, the reported pre-fine-tuning initialization reaches 77.80\%. These results support further study of geometry-aware heterogeneous fusion, but not a training-free single-checkpoint merge: RLPF is a two-branch hybrid whose gate and reported final models are trained.
articles.titleCn: 黎曼-洛伦兹视觉Transformer与状态空间模型融合
articles.abstractCn: 深度学习在扩展过程中面临关键瓶颈：数据枯竭、指数级训练成本和资源集中。模型合并技术无需梯度下降即可组合预训练模型检查点，相较于重新训练可节省数个数量级的成本。当独立训练的视觉模型架构和参数形状不同时，合并它们非常困难。现有的权重空间合并方法通常假设检查点对齐且形状兼容，而视觉转换器（ViT）和状态空间模型（SSM）使用不同的算子实现标记混合。我们研究了一种混合异构合并设置，该设置保留两种架构，并通过语义角色对齐参数组。我们提出的黎曼-洛伦兹参数融合（RLPF）方法将对齐的参数组投影到公共坐标，将选定坐标提升到双曲空间的洛伦兹双曲面模型，计算正则化测地中心，并将结果解码到两个分支。一个学习到的门用于组合每个输入的分支逻辑。组件组使用固定曲率值，归一化参数被视为欧几里得。在本文提供的实验结果中，微调系统在CIFAR-10上达到82.37%，在牛津IIIT猫数据集上达到75.04%，在ImageNet-1K上达到78.58%的Top-1准确率；相应的最佳父模型准确率分别为76.54%、71.42%和76.42%。在ImageNet-1K上，报道的预微调初始化准确率达到77.80%。这些结果支持对几何感知异构融合的进一步研究，但并非无训练的单检查点合并：RLPF是一种双分支混合模型，其门和报道的最终模型都经过训练。

articles.title: A Cross-Lingual Acoustic Disease-Alignment Framework for Respiratory Health Assessment from Spontaneous Speech
articles.abstract: Spontaneous speech offers a scalable, noninvasive signal for respiratory health assessment, yet interpretable models that generalize across languages remain challenging because disease-related acoustic changes are confounded by language-specific phonetic variation. We present CL-DAF, a Cross-Lingual Disease-Alignment Framework that identifies acoustic dimensions whose disease effects remain consistent across languages. Using 201 English and 75 newly collected Bangla speakers, we construct a common 272-dimensional acoustic representation and quantify disease alignment using signed rank-biserial effects and the Language Invariance Score. We first show that spontaneous Bangla speech separates COPD from controls (AUC 0.85); however, 133 features reverse their disease direction across languages and the full representation transfers poorly (AUC 0.49 from Bangla to English). CL-DAF isolates 26 disease-aligned features that raise AUCs to 0.825 and 0.722 from English to Bangla and Bangla to English, respectively. These findings provide a foundation for multilingual clinical speech models emphasizing pathology over language-dependent variation.
articles.titleCn: 一种用于呼吸健康评估的自发语音跨语言声学疾病对齐框架
articles.abstractCn: 自发语音为呼吸健康评估提供了一种可扩展的非侵入性信号，然而构建跨语言泛化的可解释模型仍然具有挑战性，因为与疾病相关的声学变化会被特定语言的语音变异所混淆。我们提出了CL-DAF，一个跨语言疾病对齐框架，该框架识别出在语言间保持一致的疾病效应的声学维度。使用201名英语和75名新收集的孟加拉语说话人，我们构建了一个通用的272维声学表征，并使用符号秩双尾效应和语言不变性分数来量化疾病对齐。我们首先表明，自发孟加拉语语音能够区分COPD患者与对照组（AUC 0.85）；然而，133个特征在语言间反转了其疾病方向，完整表征的迁移性能不佳（从孟加拉语迁移到英语的AUC为0.49）。CL-DAF分离出26个疾病对齐特征，将英语到孟加拉语和孟加拉语到英语的AUC分别提高到0.825和0.722。这些发现为强调病理学而非语言依赖变异的多语言临床语音模型奠定了基础。

articles.title: Less Is More: Graph-free Multimodal RAG via Multi-signal Late Fusion
articles.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.
articles.titleCn: 更少即是更多：无图多模态RAG通过多信号后期融合
articles.abstractCn: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）在多模态、跨文档问答中应用广泛。然而，构建语料库级图成本高昂、查询缓慢且难以维护。我们提出了TrioRAG，一种无图的框架，整合了三个互补信号的证据：问题、锚图像以及由两者生成的VLM增强查询。每个信号独立地在页面文本和页面图像的共享多向量索引上进行检索，并通过后期融合组合结果。此外，我们引入了AutoQA，一个多模态汽车基准，其问题基于噪声的网页图像而非干净的文档图像。这些问题需要跨手册推理。我们将其定位为模型管理的测试平台，而非人工验证的金标准。在三个基准测试中，TrioRAG与基于图的系统性能相当或更优，同时降低了总成本，并将每查询推理速度提升了1.6-2.3倍。根据设计，AutoQA将其问题基于语料库外的网页图像。在此设置下，图像检索仅达到19.3%的文档级召回率，而文本衍生信号，尤其是VLM增强查询，保持了检索的鲁棒性。

articles.title: BurnRiSc: Toward Non-Invasive Burnout Screening in Open Source from Public Repository Signals
articles.abstract: Burnout is a chronic occupational syndrome, and open source is close to a worst case for it: maintainers absorb unbounded demand with no manager to reallocate work and no organization to notice decline. The cost is not only personal. Burnout precedes withdrawal, and in projects sustained by a handful of maintainers, one departure can break infrastructure that thousands of downstream systems depend on. Yet the field has no way to see it coming: self-report inventories, the only existing measure, miss exactly the contributors most in need of detection and cannot be applied retroactively, so the field cannot even ask how common burnout is or what helps. We present BurnRiSc, a framework that operationalizes the Oldenburg Burnout Inventory's two dimensions, exhaustion and disengagement, as 14 behavioral and linguistic signals computed from GitHub activity and scored against each contributor's own history. The signals aggregate into two weighted dimension scores, with weights learned from labeled cases, and average into a monthly Burnout Risk Score (BRS). In a preliminary evaluation across 68 contributors in ten repositories (ten disclosed burnout cases, twelve comparable-volume collapses, and 46 comparison contributors), sustained BRS elevation precedes 6 of 10 disclosures by 6-15 months, 8 of 10 when adding peak BRS as a second criterion, and 10 of 10 over any prior time frame. We thus present BurnRiSc as evidence that burnout is screenable from public data.
articles.comment: 8 Pages, Submitted to the JAWs 2 Workshop
articles.titleCn: BurnRiSc：基于公共仓库信号实现开源非侵入性职业倦怠筛查
articles.abstractCn: 职业倦怠是一种慢性的职业综合征，而开源项目接近于这种综合征的最坏情况：维护者无限制地吸收需求，没有经理来重新分配工作，也没有组织来察觉衰退。其代价不仅是个人的。倦怠先于退出，在一个由少数维护者维持的项目中，一个人的离开可能破坏数千个下游系统依赖的基础设施。然而该领域没有方法来预见这种情况：自我报告清单，唯一现有的衡量标准，恰恰错过了最需要被检测的贡献者，并且无法追溯应用，因此该领域甚至无法询问倦怠的普遍程度或什么有助于缓解。我们提出了BurnRiSc框架，该框架将Oldenburg倦怠清单的两个维度——耗竭和脱离——操作化为14个从GitHub活动中计算出的行为和语言信号，并根据每个贡献者自己的历史进行评分。这些信号聚合成两个加权维度分数，权重从标记案例中学习，并平均成一个每月倦怠风险分数（BRS）。在一项初步评估中，跨越十个仓库的68位贡献者（十个公开的倦怠案例，十二个可比规模的崩溃案例，以及46个比较贡献者），持续的BRS升高在6-15个月内先于10个案例中的6个披露，当添加峰值BRS作为第二个标准时，在10个案例中的8个，并且在任何先前时间框架内都是10个案例。因此，我们提出BurnRiSc作为证据，证明倦怠可以从公开数据中检测出来。

articles.title: From Models to Systems: A Comprehensive Survey of Efficient Multimodal Learning
articles.abstract: The rapid expansion of multimodal models has surfaced formidable bottlenecks in computation, memory, and deployment, catalyzing the rise of Efficient Multimodal Learning (EML) as a pivotal research frontier. Despite intensive progress, a cohesive understanding of what, how, and where efficiency is manifested across the learning stack remains fragmented. This survey systematizes the EML landscape by introducing the first structured, model-to-system taxonomy. We distill insights from over 300 seminal works into three hierarchical levels--model, algorithm, and system--addressing architectural parsimony, execution refinement, and hardware-aware orchestration, respectively. Moving beyond a purely categorical review, we offer a methodological synthesis of the vertical synergies between these layers, elucidating how cross-layer co-design contributes to the fundamental "Efficiency-Utility-Privacy" trade-off. Through an integrative case study of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we trace the field's evolutionary trajectory from initial structural adjustments to modern full-stack resource orchestration. Furthermore, we provide a holistic discussion and application-specific optimization blueprints for diverse domains and posit a paradigm shift toward self-regulating intelligence, where efficiency is an intrinsic, emergent property of the model's fundamental design rather than a post-hoc constraint. Finally, we present open challenges and future directions that will define the trajectory of EML research. This survey establishes a structured framework for multimodal systems that are not only high-performing and generalizable but natively efficient and ready for ubiquitous deployment. A continuously updated version is available at https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey.
articles.titleCn: 从模型到系统：高效多模态学习的综合综述
articles.abstractCn: 多模态模型的快速扩张在计算、内存和部署方面暴露出严峻的瓶颈，催生了高效多模态学习（EML）作为关键研究前沿的兴起。尽管取得了密集的进展，但关于效率在学习栈中体现的“是什么、如何、在哪里”的统一理解仍然碎片化。本综述通过引入首个结构化、从模型到系统的分类体系，系统化地梳理了EML领域。我们从300多项开创性工作中提炼见解，将其分为模型、算法和系统三个层级，分别对应架构简约性、执行优化和硬件感知协调。超越单纯的分类回顾，我们提出了这些层级之间的垂直协同方法学，阐明跨层协同设计如何影响“效率-效用-隐私”这一基本权衡。通过多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的综合案例研究，我们追溯了该领域从初始结构调整到现代全栈资源协调的演进轨迹。此外，我们针对不同领域提供了整体讨论和特定应用的优化蓝图，并提出了向自调节智能的范式转变，其中效率是模型基本设计固有的、涌现的属性，而非事后约束。最后，我们提出了定义EML研究方向轨迹的开放性挑战和未来方向。本综述为不仅高性能、通用性强，而且原生高效、随时准备进行普遍部署的多模态系统建立了结构化框架。持续更新的版本可在https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey获取。

articles.title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.
articles.titleCn: 界面之外的保障：通过大型语言模型的潜在状态检测危害
articles.abstractCn: 自主系统越来越多地依赖大型语言模型（LLM），但围绕这些模型的安全基础设施引入了延迟和计算开销。这限制了在资源受限、时间关键型部署中的实用性。现有的外部防护模型仍然对模型的内部运作一无所知，造成了根本性的保证差距。我们提出：模型是否已经知道内容有害？我们从LLaMA-3.1-8B中提取激活信息，并训练轻量级的多层感知器分类器探针（1260万个参数），用于检测有害提示。在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上的评估显示，我们的探针分别达到了99%、83%和84%的F1分数，与1000倍大的防护模型相比具有竞争力，同时降低了延迟和计算成本。

articles.title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
articles.abstract: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.
articles.titleCn: 仅供您阅：评估孤立语言模型实例间的协调性
articles.abstractCn: 随着模型生成内容越来越多地被自动化工作流中的其他模型实例所消费，一个具有重要实践意义的问题随之产生：模型能否在自然语言中嵌入一个信号，使得同一模型的独立实例能够仅依靠共享的预训练和任务指令来检测该信号，而无需任何共享记忆或特定于协调的训练？我们介绍了“仅供您目视”，这是一个旨在直接评估这一能力的合作信号传递游戏。发送者需要为两个单词生成自由形式的描述，其中一个为隐藏的目标词；而隔离的接收者必须识别出该目标词。我们在四个架构系列中的七个当代模型上，使用已建立的心理学语言库中的300对单词进行了评估，并采用双通道成功率来控制输出偏差。我们发现，大多数模型在需要避免可检测信号时难以维持协调，而一个前沿模型在经过此类过滤后仍能保持近乎完美的性能。我们进一步表明，模型可以将这种能力导向有意误导，并且跨架构的协调始终比架构内部的协调更弱。
